description:
Hello dear guest, located in the Beyoğlu district of Istanbul, this cute apartment of 65 square meters consists of a bedroom, a living room, 1 bathroom and a kitchen area. In addition to providing you with a unique accommodation during your trip, it will also be a great advantage that it is within walking distance of all historical and touristic places.

The facilities we offer you throughout your trip will be enough for you to just grab your bag and come home.

reviews.text:
I had a great stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The place looks exactly like the photos—beautiful and stylish, with impressively high ceilings that make it feel very spacious. The bed and pillows were super comfortable, and overall the apartment was clean and well-equipped.
There was a scheduled water outage during my stay, but the host informed me in advance, which I really appreciated.
While the soundproofing isn’t perfect, the neighborhood is quiet so it wasn’t an issue. The Wi-Fi occasionally dropped out, but it seemed like a general connection problem rather than something specific to the apartment. There was also a temporary power outage in the building, again outside the host's control.
All in all, a lovely place with great vibes. I’d definitely stay here again!

The apartment is beautiful, exactly as described and shown in the photos. It is located in the old city, so everything is practically walkable. The tram (T1) is a 3-5 minute walk and plenty of restaurants nearby. There is a store right around the corner that stays open late past 00:00 where you can buy almost all your necessities (water, toilet paper, napkins, snacks, cheeses and olives too).
About a 10 minute walk uphill and you’ll be on the Istiklal Caddesi street which stretches with hundreds of stores and restaurants and bars. Not to mention on that same road, there’s the M2 metro. Overall everything was convenient to get to.
Ferhat is an amazing host. Always responsive and happy to help. Truly a great experience and would come again!

I stayed at Fernando's apartment for 4 nights with my Mom and we enjoyed our stay! The place was clean and pleasant, easy to find, and check-in and check-out were smooth. Fernando was very helpful, friendly and responsive.
The kitchen had almost everything you need, though I personally would have appreciated a toaster and a dishwasher. One of the bar stools is missing a leg, so just something to be careful with. Otherwise the kitchen is perfectly suitable for everyday cooking. Special thanks for the water left in the fridge!
The bedroom was small but nice and cozy. I was happy it had blackout curtains, which is very important for me. The only downside for me were the pillows – they were a bit too high, so I struggled to get comfortable. Otherwise I slept well. It's not very clear from the pictures, but the balcony doesn’t really have a view – it overlooks a roof with cats and seagulls. I didn’t mind it though, it was actually fun watching the cats just living their Istanbul lives :)

We had a great stay at Ferhat’s place! The location was super convenient and within walking distance to everything I needed. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and just as described. Ferhat was a very responsive and helpful host quick to reply and always willing to assist with any questions. I’d definitely recommend.

Very cozy comfortable and clean place.And as the location is in on side street it was peaceful. Location is great. Very close to so many great neighborhoods restaurants, shops, historical sites etc. I felt very at home there. Communication from host was excellent. Gave very detailed directions and I structions for checking in with photo of building.. I had some trouble opening the door when I arrived, and Fernando got immediately back to me after I messaged and checked in to make sure I was okay. I would highly recommend

description: Come and stay in this private, quiet and simple house, located in the heart of the city center. This spacious house is perfect for a group of travel companions or a family looking for a peaceful stay. Enjoy walking everywhere in this apartment in the heart of Istanbul. Our house is centrally located to many restaurants and shopping. Amenities include High Speed Wi-Fi, Fully equipped kitchen - Washing machine and dryer.

reviews.text:
Zafer’s apartment was really beautiful inside. After being in the city all day, the apartment was a welcomed reprieve and very spacious. The couch was super large and very comfortable. The huge windows allowed for so much natural light. We stayed for a month, so the well-equipped kitchen was perfect for cooking. The bedrooms had huge windows as well, and when the windows were open, you could hear so many birds chirping in the morning.
Other things about the area: there is a very large city park nearby. It was lovely to walk through the nature after being in a crowded city all day. The ferry port is about a 15 minute walk, so it made it convenient to get to different areas. The metro was about a 20 minute walk. So many markets, grocery stores, restaurants and coffee shops all within a 2-15 min walk.
We were happy not being in the city center after long days of sights, crowds, and walking. More locals in this area than tourists. If you are looking for an authentic feel, this is it.

Great apartment, stayed here for a week. Clean, a lot of place (enough for ~7 person). Dishwasher, oven, fridge, washing machine. A lot of dishes.
Good internet, but works good in the living room and works badly (lost connection sometimes) in the bedrooms.
Really recommend this place to stay, city center, 10 minutes to Dolmabahce, a lot of restaurants near.

We were extremely disappointed with our stay. The apartment lost power twice, including for an entire night, leaving us without electricity, water, or an elevator. Because it was on the eighth floor and my mother-in-law uses a wheelchair, we had to carry her downstairs, which was dangerous and unacceptable.
Communication was delayed, and the overnight outage occurred on my wife’s 40th birthday, the main reason for our trip. We accepted a much smaller apartment because we had no alternative. Although compensation was promised, nothing was provided.

We had a wonderful time at Zafer’s place—it was a fantastic home base for our large family. Finding a home that actually feels spacious enough for a big group can be tough, but this was perfect, and having that extra half-bathroom was a total lifesaver!
​The kitchen was well-stocked with plenty of utensils for meals in, but the location is also unbeatable with so many walkable spots and easy access to the metro. We loved the comfortable furniture and especially enjoyed starting our mornings with coffee in the outdoor space when the weather was nice. Thank you, Zafer—we would stay here again!

Zafer and Bedirhan are great hosts. The flat is gorgeous. It is greatly located, quiet, and big enough to feel at home. Great food and multiple shops are in walking distance.
Zafer and Bedirhan were always very friendly and helpful with our wishes.
Their positive and proactive attitude made our stay a great occasion.
We hope to stay in their place again in our next visit.

description:
Welcome to our place, ideally situated on a lively street filled with bars, restaurants, and supermarkets.Nestled in the heart of the vibrant entertainment district, our place offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience for a nice stay.

Location Highlights:
*Entertainment: Our place is surrounded by lively bars offering a perfect setting for a night out or a relaxing drink after a day of exploring.
*Delights: a variety of restaurants all within walking distance from our doorstep.

reviews.text:
This place is like a hotel room in a building - right in the heart of Besiktas area. I particularly liked this place because the area is very happening; there are hundreds of cafes and restaurants nearby; this gives you the feel of European city center.
The room is super clean; all Furnitures are new and functioning. The towels and linens are super white. I like to stay in places like this.
The room temperature could be adjusted through the AC to fit my liking; helped to stay warm in the middle of freezing cold.
The communication with the host was good; I did not meet the host, but didnt find any challenge with the communication.
Overall. I recommend this place for a few days stay in Istanbul.

The description was accurate.
Nice location, clean room, easy to find and to check-in. The place was well equipped and everything was functional.
The host was responsive and polite.

Beşiktaşın tam merkezinde, klimalı ve yeni sayılabilecek bir binada güzel bir stüdyo daire. Tam olarak fiyat/performans yeri diyebilirim. Amacınız çok lüks ve büyük bir dairede vakit geçirmek yerine Istanbul'u gezmek, her yere rahatça yürüyerek veya taksiyle ulaşabilmek ve gece odada uyumak ise sizin için biçilmiş kaftan. Ayrıca otel hizmetine benzer hizmetleri de var, tertemiz nevresim ve havlular, duş jeli ve şampuan, çay kahve, terlik vs. Konforlu ve güzel.

En buyuk avantaji bulundugu bolge. Uygulamadaki konumu yanlisti ne google haritalarda ne apple haritalarda duzgun gozukmuyordu. Ev sahibine yazmasam bulamazdım evi. Tuvaletteki giderle ilgili kotu koku probleminin cozulmesi gerek. İcerde klima olmasina ragmen kumandasi calismiyordu piller oksitlenmisti. İnternet hizi cok yavasti, tv de bir seyler izlemek iskence. Lavabo altindaki cop atilmamisti ve kokuyordu. İcerde tek kullanimlik terlik birakmamislardi, odan girisinin yanindaki ufak dolaptan hem terlik hem fazladan tuvalet kagidini kendimiz aldik. Ev sahibiyle iletisimimiz guzeldi. Kibar bir insan, yardimci olmaya calisti ancak bulundugu konuma ragmen ucret biraz fazlaydi bence. O fiyata cok daha iyi odalar var.
Perfect! With great location , it’s only about few steps from local shops, restaurants, and we felt welcome! thanks to Adem for the great hospitality!

description:
Experience the perfect stay in Istanbul's historic peninsula!

This booking offers a modern apartment in Old Town Istanbul, neighboring the historic monuments such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and more.

The tram station around the corner is your easy access to the other side of the Golden Horn for the Galata Tower, Galataport, Istanbul Modern Museum, nightlife, and shopping.

With our daily cleaning and dedicated concierge service, we ensure a memorable vacation!

reviews.text:
The location was great for exploring Istanbul via foot, tram and Metro. The property is walking distance of most tourist attractions. The metro stop is less than a minute away from the hotel so it’s worth noting this provides a bit of a soundtrack throughout the day and evening.
Elif was a great host and communicated information ahead of time. Any small issues we had during our stay, she resolved them promptly. We found her to be very friendly.
The property itself was modern and spacious. The bed linen and towels were clean however, we found the floor to be in need of mopping.
If there was one thing we could change it would be the addition of a small sink in the kitchen area. The kettle and microwave were handy.

Stayed as a single female traveler on my first trip to Istanbul. I felt completely safe in this area, and comfortable in the accommodation. The Gulhane tram right outside unlocked easy access to everything you want to see, plus it's such a short walk to the oldest, best sites. The convenience of an elevator meant I explored more, it was so easy to come and go after long days on your feet. I also loved the hot shower! I did have a few questions during my stay and I always got quick, friendly support. Apartment was clean, bed was comfy, wifi was strong. I can't imagine a better spot when in Istanbul.

Elif was very good host, very responsive and helpful. The accomodation was clean, new and comfortable, everything is in place, the location is great, very close to the mainc sightseeings, however the street is noisy, because the metro/tram is going through the street and makes a lot of noise. Other than that, everything was perfect.

We had a great stay at Elif’s, the apartment is in a perfect location for sightseeing, trams, ferries and the metro. She was very responsive and resolved any small issues we had straight away. The apartment was also cleaned on a daily basis and was spotless. One small thing; the kitchenette has frying pans and chefs knives, but no hob, oven or microwave. This didn’t spoil the experience and we would stay here every-time we are back.

We enjoyed our stay at Urban Quarters. It was as described, the space was cleaned and tidied on request. Location was superb for local attractions, walking distance to the main ones, tram stop on the doorstep and the ferry services only 5 minutes walk. Several small supermarkets were close by for milk, fruit etc. Plus literally 100s of eating out options within a few minutes walk.

description: Enjoy a stylish 2BR rooftop duplex in the heart of Cihangir, featuring a private terrace, bright living areas, exposed brick details, and a fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for long or short stays, the apartment offers fast Wi-Fi, air conditioning, comfortable bedrooms, and a warm modern design. Located steps from cafés, vintage shops, and transport links, it’s the ideal base for exploring Istanbul.

reviews.text:
I stayed here for a week, and it was clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. It’s conveniently located with many restaurants nearby, and everything is within easy reach.
Unfortunately, like many places in Istanbul, this house has quite a few stairs and is located on the fourth level.
The two bedrooms are clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The kitchen is also clean and includes all the necessary facilities and cutlery.
Host also has quick communication/response.
Highly recommended 😊

We spent a wonderful 5 nights at Hanemo's apartment in early June 2025. Great place! Exactly as pictured and described. Easy access, with clear instructions. Fantastic location! 15-min walk to Taksim or Galata, with much to see and do along the way. Shops and bars and grocery stores within 5-min walk. The terrace off the kitchen was a great place for coffee in the morning and a drink in the evening. The apartment itself was attractive, clean, and fully functional. We felt right at home from the moment we walked in. Hanemo was a wonderful host and super-responsive. I don't think any response took more than 30 minutes - even when the question was clearly not time-sensitive. No elevator, so pack light or be prepared to carry bags up 3 flights. (We knew this going in and were not surprised or bothered by it at all.) We loved this apartment and would highly recommend it. Thanks, Hanemo, for a wonderful stay!

We stayed at Hanemo’s place in Istanbul for a period of 4 nights. Overall, it was a good experience — the apartment was clean, the location was convenient, and Hanemo was a very communicative and helpful host, providing all the details we asked for.
That said, the furniture and some objects in the apartment are not as new as they look in the photos. A few items could use some maintenance — for example, some picture frames were missing parts, and the flooring had small gaps between the panels. It would also be good to add some anti-slip protection on the marble stairs that lead to the apartment, as they can be a bit slippery.
Overall, though, it was a good stay with a corect price–quality ratio.

This duplex apartment and the location is all that we could’ve asked for. The bedrooms were clean and airy with big windows for sunlight and the master on the main floor has its own attached balcony as well. The second bedroom is located upstairs which has easy access to the huge terrace and kitchen.
I loved the fact that all windows open to let in the fresh air but they also have aircon on both levels for the summer season.
There’s a big tv in the living room for your nights in and can enjoy the smart tv options.
Bathroom has your basic amenities from shampoo, body wash, to hand soap in case you forgot to pack yours.
There a small little local run convenience store right opposite the building entrance where you can buy the necessities without needing to walk anywhere.
Over all I love the stay. Felt super safe and quiet yet surrounded by busy eateries, coffee shops (vasalisa was our go to morning stop), and bars. It an easy downhill walk to Galata Tower, Taksim, and Galata port

I had a very convenient stay, I wish it was a bit longer than just 3 days! The checkin was easy, just note that it’s a duplex on the top floor, so you’ll need to walk some stairs. The positive thing is that the stairs are wide enough to carry luggage upstairs with comfort.
The apartment was clean, well designed and quite spacious. Communication with the proactive host was pleasant.
The area is very close to either Taksim, Galata or Karaköy. Also in the neighborhood itself (Cihangir) there are plenty of cafes, bars and restaurants that will make your stay even better!

description: This room is a beautifully designed Studio which offers everything you need for a short term stay. The studio offers a private bathroom with shower, a well equipped small kitchenette, a large size tv, free wifi, A.C. and central heating. Free room service once every 2 day and 24 hours doorman makes your stay more comfortable. You can also enjoy your coffee at the 18 hours available information desk while you are getting information about secrets of city or answers of your questions.

reviews.text:
I enjoyed very much my stay at Amir hotel. Erol was very kind and always helpful, he helped me with my luggage and transfer to airport which was very useful, he also gave advises about places to visit and restaurants. There were several options of transfer from and to the airport. The hotel is situated in a very central area and most of the main touristic attractions are accessible on foot. However the restaurants in the area are rather expensive so I often had to go farther.
The appartement was a bit smaller than I imagined but for a short-stay was totally fine. There was everything that I needed. I didn't have an occasion to use the kitchen facilities though, as I didn't find a big enough supermarket in the area so it was easier to eat outdoors. But I liked drinking tea and coffee kindly provided by Erol in the room.
The appartment was also very clean, and I didn't have any problems with noise. So I definitely recommend this place for a discovery of Istanbul!

This was a deeply disappointing experience and far below acceptable Airbnb standards.
The room does not match the photos at all it is significantly smaller and clearly misrepresented. The flooring is damaged and swollen, with a strong moldy smell throughout the space. Cleanliness is unacceptable: there was human hair on the floor, and the walls are dirty, covered in stains and scratches.
Privacy was also violated. We were not informed about any housekeeping, yet someone entered the room without notice to change the bed linens. This is completely unacceptable.
The bathroom is in terrible condition. There is a strong sewage smell, the hot water has almost no pressure and cannot be properly adjusted, and the shower head is broken and barely functional. Access to the room is unsafe the stairs are extremely narrow and dangerous, posing a real risk of falling.
Overall, the price is completely unjustified.
I strongly do not recommend staying here!!

We had an amazing stay. The room looked exactly like on the photos, everything was clean and tidied every 2 days. The location is very central in Sultanahmet and close to the blue mosque. Everything is very walkable, we never used a taxi or public transport (other than going to the airport). The host even organized a taxi to the airport for us so we didn't have to worry about anything at all.
We had an amazing stay, Erol was helpful & the hotel was clean and very well priced for the location. Amazing thank you for having us 🥰

We stayed at the lovely Emir hotel for the second time in 3 months! It was absolutely wonderful and we felt right at home in this cosy room. We love the room aesthetic and how clean it is! The bed is so comfortable and the little kitchenette and bathroom are perfect for a 3 night stay. It is so close to all the main attractions in Istanbul which is a bonus :) Velat made us feel so warm and welcomed for our second trip back and we even received a room upgrade. He was fantastic! Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Istanbul!

description: A twin room with its own ensuite shower and bathroom. We are located 10 minutes away from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia, the center of Sultanahmet, Istanbul's major tourist area. From here you can easily take the tram to explore other areas of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Communication and check-in with Kamuran was very easy, the room looked exactly as it was described. Very clean. Location is very close to many of tourist attractions on Ippodrome square. Apartment is 10 min by foot to T1 Sultanahmet tram stop
I was able to cook in the well-equipped kitchen which was on a ground floor, but there is no room for eating there (as you can see from the photos) so I ate in my room which was on the 1st floor (I was aware of it before booking, so no suprise).
Kamuran is a great host, very caring, helpful and open to your needs. The room itself is cozy but small (you can see it from photos as well). Since I stayed just by myself, that was alright but I'm not sure if that space was enough for 2 people travelling together. It depends on your requirements.

Perfect location from which to reach many major points of interest on foot. It is very conveniently located and easy to find. The room is clean, neat; the bed comfortable; the shower is roomy with plenty of hot water. The photos and descriptions accurately portray the accommodations. The rooftop terrace has a wonderful view, and common kitchen is very well equipped. Just keep in mind that the room is extremely small, approx. 120 sq. ft. (11 sq. meters). This was not a problem for us since we were out and about as much as possible to see as much of Istanbul as we could fit into our short stay.

I stayed with my friend for one week, and we truly felt at home.
The flat is located in a beautiful, fully touristic area — which means restaurants and shops nearby can be a bit pricey.
I recommend walking a bit farther toward the center if you’re looking for more reasonable prices.
I wouldn’t recommend renting a car, as parking is difficult to find and traffic can be heavy.
The T1 tram line is only about a 10-minute walk from the flat (note: the walk includes a short uphill stretch of about 300 meters) and it connects you to many main tourist attractions.
The neighborhood felt 100% safe. We even left cash and a laptop in the apartment without any worries.
Kamuran is a lovely host — kind, helpful, and always available when we needed her. She speaks both English and Turkish, which made communication easy.
Thank you, Kamuran, for making our stay so pleasant! 🌿

It was a perfect stay for us. The room was clean, cozy, and comfortable. Beds were great. Bathroom was clean, comfortable, and always had hot water available. The best part however was the host. Kamuran was so friendly and welcoming. Easy and fast to communicate with. Thank you so much for a great stay during our time in Istanbul.

Nice and clean room, great location for great price for someone visiting Istanbul for first time. Most attractions are walking distance and for far away places trams are nearby that are much quicker and cheaper than taxis. The Hosts were really friendly, responsive and flexible.

description: Enjoy a simple and cozy stay in this centrally located quiet place.

reviews.text:
Great stay!
The apartment was exactly as described: clean, well-equipped, and very well located. The sea view is simply extraordinary, a real pleasure every morning. The host was responsive, welcoming, and very professional. We had an excellent time and would gladly come back. I highly recommend this accommodation!

reviews.text:
My family had a wonderful stay at Eren’s place in Istanbul. The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and just as described. The location is excellent, with public transport nearby, which made it really easy to get around the city. Eren was a very responsive and helpful host, always quick to answer my questions. He even provided a baby crib for us, which was very thoughtful.
I’d definitely recommend staying here to anyone visiting Istanbul.

I was very pleased with the kindness of Mr. Eren. The apartment is clean and located in public but nice area. In front of you you can find a small market where you can buy your daily staff. There is also close market for fresh bread. If you want to go to other parts of Istanbul, you can just take the train which is located a few minutes walking away from the apartment. I enjoyed my stay with my family. Thank you Eren.

Great experience, great apartment and great owner, responsive, responsible, answers all questions, the apartment has everything you need inside, it seems to me even more like for a rented potion. Our comfort was taken care of, for which special thanks. Next time in Istanbul we will be happy to stay here again.

Great treat and attentions where given with Eren, he was super friendly and helped us with everything we needed, we asked for something else to get warmer since we are not used to the cold weather, and he super fast solved it for us! would 100 % recommend to stay with him. The house is so beautiful and clean. definitely would come back! thank you

Evden ve seyahatimden memnun kaldım ve imkan dahilinde olursa tekrar konaklayacağım bir yer. Erken giriş yapmamıza olanak sağlandı. Ev genel olarak temiz her türlü imkan var en önemlisi konforlu ve sıcak bir ev. Market ve yeme/içme konusunda sorunsuz. Ulaşım ise marmaraya 5 dakika mesafede olması sebebiyle çok çok rahat.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby. You'll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text: Everything was as described. Clean kitchen, toilet and bed. The parking garage under the building is also a big plus. I would definitely recommend the place.

fotoğraflardan bir farkı yoktu ev gayet düzenli ve temiz bırakılmıştı evde ihtiyacınızı karşılayan herşey mevcuttu geniş ferah ve güzel manzarlıydı hijyen konusunu takanların düşünmeden girebileceği biryer oldugunu düşünüyorum ev sahibimiz oldukça ilgiliydi tekrardan teşekkür ederiz.

My daughter and I missed our flight to Morocco. Were supposed to be visiting my husband's family, but luckily we were able to find an Airbnb in Istanbul, Turkey. The place is exactly like the picture everyone was so welcoming. I also love that they have everything you need inside the villa.
It was great place with a friendly host
Akdlnn est super réactif et très sympa nous avons passé un excellent séjour je recommande à 100%

description: Our facility is located in the oldest part of Istanbul. What we love about being in our neighborhood is that you are located between 6 amazing 'must see' areas in the heart of Istanbul - Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and Sultanahmet Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Istanbul Archaeological Museum complex. Many of Istanbul's most popular attractions are within a 10-minute walk - our location is super central and there is no need to take the metro or bus after checking in.

reviews.text:
Great stay for a family! The location is very strategic, close to Beyazit Tram Station, although there is a little uphill walk 😄 Shops, restaurants, laundry, and a mosque are all nearby, while the neighborhood is quiet at night.
The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The AC worked well, and the cleaning service was excellent. There is no elevator, so the ground or first floor is recommended if you have heavy luggage or a stroller.
The best part was Mr. Safeer — extremely helpful, polite, and always quick to respond. If the rating is 1–10, I give him 100! His team was also fantastic.
Great value, great location, and amazing hospitality. Highly recommended for families. We would definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay in Istanbul! The host was incredibly kind and friendly, and provided us with a lot of helpful assistance throughout our trip.
The location is very convenient, situated on a sloped street with small grocery stores and restaurants nearby—there’s an excellent kebab restaurant right across the street that we highly recommend! Major attractions like the Grand Bazaar and the Blue Mosque are all within walking distance, which made exploring the city very easy.
The apartment itself is clean and well-lit, and it comes with a simple but functional kitchen, which we really appreciated. Please note that there is no elevator or washing machine, but there is a laundromat nearby, so it wasn’t an issue for us.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend this place to others!

Lovely apartment hotel within walking distance to many of Istanbul’s major attractions. Upon arrival, the host, Sefer made me feel immediately welcome with his warm attitude. The rooms are comfortable and clean, and the street is fairly quiet at night. Would stay again!

We stayed 16 days in July/August 2026 and it exceeded every expectation. The location in Laleli is unbeatable : Grand Bazaar, Spice Bazaar, Sultanahmet and Eminönü all walkable, with excellent metro and tram connections nearby.
The apartment was spotlessly clean, airy and well air-conditioned, essential in Istanbul summer. The compact kitchen worked perfectly for self-catering breakfasts and dinners, saving us a lot over 16 days.
The staff made all the difference. The gentleman at reception, whose name we never caught, showed us a level of warmth and kindness that transcended any language barrier. Pure genuine hospitality. A special thank you also to our host who provided all instructions and information we needed from day one.
If the rating allowed more than 5 stars, we would give it without hesitation. We will absolutely return.

Great place, very friendly host. Room is nice and tidy, just as on the pictures. Location is good if you plan to be often around the Grand Bazaar, its like 15min walk. Not too loud, for this price can not complain. Do not expect luxury but we were fully satisfied.

description:
Beautiful and comfortable apartment in the heart of Istanbul, perfect for families or small groups.

🏡 Two bedrooms
🛋️ Spacious living room
🍳 Fully equipped kitchen with natural gas stove
🧺 Washing machine & refrigerator

📍 Amazing central location
* 2 min walk to Galata Tower
* 4 min walk to Galataport

Cafés, markets and metro are all nearby.
We would be happy to host you in our apartment 😊

Best regards,
Şaban

reviews.text:
Nice apartment in a very good and central location, close to the Galata tower.
The apartment is on the fifth floor (no elevator, but for us it was not a problem), and there was a rooftop terrace which was not mentioned in the description so it was a very pleasant surprise :) The view was great, and it was close to everything. Nice cafes and brunch places at the nearby as well.
Towels and bedsheets were provided, though there was only one big blanket per double bed, so if you are travelling as a group of friends and not as a couples it’s not that comfortable, but alltogether it was a very nice experience. The host was helpful and replied very quickly to every questions.

We stayed at this Airbnb as a group of six with my family, it was a great experience. The location is excellent, just a 4-5 minutes walk to Galata Tower, Galataport, and the Bosphorus seaside, which made exploring the city very convenient.
The apartment itself was very well-equipped, and everything inside new and thoughtfully arranged. It was comfortable, clean, and perfectly suited for our stay.
The host was also extremely helpful and responsive, which made the whole experience even easier🤩
Thank you for all Şaban.
İ would definitely choose your apartment again for sure.

This Airbnb needs major improvement.
Pros:

description:
Situated in the Heart of Istanbul, right on Meşrutiyet Street, near metro station, 2 min to Galata Tower and Istiklal Avenue, simply location is unbeatable. The apartment was kept with the historic feeling of its 107 years old building with a modern touch.

Our apartment is recently renovated and brand new furnished. The building is equipped with an elevator (rare to find). We have specially designed this apartment both for couples and families/groups who prefer a peaceful and luxurious stay.

reviews.text: Our host was very responsive, but didn't give us the accurate route to get from the airport to his place. The building check in procedure was well described. The apartment is in a great neighbourhood, with coffee shops, a grocery store and near public transport. It would be nice to offer guests recommandations about the area and main attractions. On our second day, we received a link with very basic info, but we had already figured out our itinerary. Although the apartment is clean, it lacks major attention to detail. It seems to have been put together quickly, with the cheapest materials possible. The shower head is cracked and leaks, and the flimsy shower doors don't close all the way. The beds are okay, but the cheap pillows are not comfortable. Washer and dryer are big plus. Be aware that you must go through the back bedroom to get to the bathroom. Front bedroom is on the street side (3rd floor) so it's noisy. Overall a good place, but I'm not sure why it's rated as a super host.

Some good things: the location is terrific, and Cordo is very helpful and responsive. The building is quite safe, and the elevator works well.
Some bad things: the photos do not accurately portray this apartment. The second bedroom has no door to it, so anything going on in the living room or kitchen is heard in that bedroom. The street noise is extreme (and I say this as someone who has lived all her life in NYC), making it quite difficult to sleep there. The living room is tiny, the couch is tiny and uncomfortable, and the rug in front of the couch is literally a bathmat. The single bathroom, off the primary bedroom, floods if the water in the shower is on too high, and there is water damage on the ceiling.

Great stay. check-in was straightforward, the location is excellent you're right in the middle of everything, with restaurants, cafés and the tram all within easy walking distance. The apartment was clean, comfortable and exactly as shown in the listing, and the elevator was a big help after a long day of walking around the city.
We travelled as a family, and it worked well for us. Would happily stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The hosts were quite friendly and welcoming. However, since many travelers rely on reviews before booking, I want to ensure my comments help others make an informed decision.
Location:
The apartment is located about 5 minutes from Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, which is convenient. However, the walk is very steep and uphill. Even as a relatively fit 40-year-old, I found it physically challenging, especially in Istanbul’s summer heat. You are likely to be out of breath and sweaty by the time you reach the top. That said, the neighborhood felt safe, and there are several shops nearby for water and other essentials.
The Apartment:
In terms of value, the apartment was disappointing. I paid nearly twice the price of a similar unit just a street away, yet the condition did not justify the cost. The sofas had multiple iron burn marks, and the toiletries provided were old, previously used bottles of hand soap, shampoo, and body wash, which I found unhygienic. There was no drinking water

reviews.text: Ali’s place is wonderful! It is as described, and Ali is an attentive and thoughtful host. He offered lots of restaurant recommendations and allowed us to check in a little early. description:
Fully renovated private studio in hotel area of Taksim square. Taksim is one of the two centres of Istanbul.
Apartment is on the second floor without elevator.
This studio is in a relatively quite area next to Taksim square and walking distance to Istiklal street.
- Metro and airport shuttle stations are within 5-min distance.
- Unlimited stably working Wifi enables homeworking
- Washing machine and dryer are to share with other studios on the same floor.

reviews.text: This is a good place. It's not big--the property is a large single room with a bathroom and small kitchenette and dining area. I stayed there one month and was fine with this. The neighborhood is in a district where there are many hotels, but one advantage of this is that the street is well-lit and there are many people around at all hours. Walking home late at night I felt very comfortable. It's also five minutes from Taksim Square, so I think some in Istanbul for tourism would find that very convenient. There's a bit of street and inside-the-building noise from time to time, but that can happen no matter where you stay in Istanbul. The price is definitely right, as you're getting a clean, recently renovated property that has just about anything you could need (other than a washing machine, but there's a full-service laundromat 20m away). Ozgur is a very good host. It's self check-in, but his instructions are clear and it's easy. Small issues were quickly resolved. Very responsive.

Really nice, clean, and cozy studio apartment near Taksim Square. It’s close enough that you’re right within the Taksim area, but away enough on a quieter side street that it still felt quiet & peaceful. There were also lots of establishments nearby which made things really convenient… restaurants, small shops, hotels, phone shops, laundromats, and even a printing shop all within walking distance.
The bed was so comfortable that getting up in the morning was a struggle 😂
The streets around the neighborhood are VERY hilly and some quite steep, so expect a bit of uphill walking. The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator, so it may not be ideal if you’re travelling with large/heavy luggage.
Overall though, we had a very comfortable stay. 😊

I stayed in Özgür's place for 2 months working remotely.
A few things stood out to me at first: Özgür was very friendly and responsive, and the place was clean (except the rug, which I recommend just removing).
The apartment is small but had everything one can need for a comfortable short to medium stay.
The building is in the area where many hotels and Airbnbs are, yet it's not really a touristy spot, so for the most part it's quite peaceful.
Staying a long time, I've experienced some issues with internet not being very stable (I recommend to have a eSIM or similar as back up), a few power or water outages and construction work that produced some noises and dust.
The apartment also neighbours with two others of Özgür's, and this means that you can come hear noises from other guests.
All these were out of Özgür's control though, and he was always receptive and helpful, doing his best to address everything.
Overall, I happily recommend this place, especially for shorter stays :)

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment is recently renovated, very clean, and you can immediately feel the freshness as soon as you walk in — it even smells new. Everything was comfortable and well taken care of, which made the experience even better. Highly recommended! Appartement price is excellent. Thank you Ozgur

description: One of Istanbul’s highest-value residential projects in the heart of Taksim. reviews.text: Charming little place within walking distance to Taksim Square. Ugar was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay. I had a few requests, and he was more than happy to accommodate them. After six weeks of travelling and staying in and out of hotels, stepping into Ugar’s apartment truly felt like coming home. The bed was comfortable, the room nice and dark for a restful sleep, and the building felt safe and secure. I’d happily recommend this place. The only small issue was the lack of cutlery in the kitchen - likely just an oversight that I’m sure will be sorted quickly.
We loved the place , very comfortable, clean . The staff was responsive. Everything went perfectly, I recommend it!

Konakladığımı yer Taksim Meydanı'na oldukça yakın, yeni yapılardan oluşan, kendi otoparkına ve güvenliğine sahip nezih bir yerdi. Girişte yönlendirme yapan Ömer Bey çok hoş bir şekilde karşılama yaptı, konaklayacağım yere kadar götürdü, çok ilgili ve güler yüzlü biriydi. Daire oldukça temizdi, yemek yapmak için birçok imkan mevcuttu. Kısacası konaklama için seçilecek kusursuz bir yer, tekrar mutlaka geleceğim.

The place was amazing. It has everything needed for our stay. The host was very friendly and communicative, always offering help! The only thing that was a small problem for us was the dirty environment - basically the whole neighbourhood is a huge construction site with materials stored everywhere. Also every morning the construction workers will start making noise around 8am (including the weekend) so that's something to keep in mind.

My husband and I had an amazing stay! The apartment was exactly what we needed after having spent 10 days in a room on a cruise. The host was super accommodating and friendly. The proximity to sights and restaurants was convenient. The washing machine was an added bonus. We would definitely stay here again!

description:
This apartment is on the ground floor. Although the house itself holds a lot of stories from a century and a half ago, our goal is to offer you a fairy-tale-like stay.
We renovated the house in 2021 and restored the old furniture. We made curtains from the etamine fabric that my mother made with her own hands.
I hope the repainted walls will witness you having a pleasant time, and these moments, which you will remember as memories in the future, will always bring a sweet smile to your face. We look forward to seeing you.

reviews.text: Lena is a good Host, but this property is not very comfortable. Its way uphill, which is beautiful for views, but something to keep in mind and to be shared beforehand. The wooden walls of the house make the environment very noisy, even if its quiet. The neighbours across the street were hosting a party, no problem, but you could hear everything even though all windows were closed. As if they were standing in front of the window. The host lives above the apartment. I think there's a bathroom above the bedroom. If the host is walking about there, or doing anything else, your hear everything. The other way around it is most likely the same. Not very private. The bed is also terrible and needs to be replaced. If you're okay with all of this, it is a good place and the island is beautiful!

We had a very pleasant stay. The apartment is lovely, clean, well kept and comfortable, and it was a great base for our time on Heybeliada. What we appreciated most, however, was Lena’s kindness and availability: she was always friendly, responsive and very helpful whenever we needed information or support. Communication was easy throughout our stay and we felt very welcome. We would definitely recommend the apartment and would be happy to stay here again.

Lena’s place is just perfect : very clean and cosy, the flat ia arranged with love and care. The location is great - it’s 5-10 mins walk from the centre, and at the same time its deeper in the island which is much much better than being in the tourist areas, it gives you a taste to discover other areas and be in midst of local authentic life. Lena is such a kind and welcoming host 🤍🤍🤍

Oncelikle Lena’ya tesekkur ederiz. Yeri bulma konusunda cok yardimci oldu. Ev cok guzeldi, temizdi ve esyalar cok hostu. Ben cok memnun kaldim. Ozellikle temizlik ❤️

Lena gerçekten harika bir ev sahibi, her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz. Heybeliada’ya tekrar gidersem kesinlikle burada kalırım. Şiddetle tavsiye edilir!!

description: Have a pleasant time with your whole family in this stylish place. We serve with a studio apartment with daily cleaning, American kitchen and washing machine in our facility, which is very close to all the touristic places of the city. We would be happy to host you.

reviews.text: Mehmet's place is a great base for exploring Istabul - close to the waterfront, metro and trams as well as walking distance to all the local sites and mosques. I was on the first floor and had no trouble with street noise. The room itself was larger than I thought and very well equipped with everything I needed.

Fantastic stay! House is very clean, very nice, and you cannot beat the location. Walking distance to everything.
Mehmet is a great host. He communicated very well and arranged airport pickup. I will be staying here again in the future.
Perfect host!!! This is the best place where to stay if you are travelling to Istanbul the house is very clean next to the park , very well located.

Wir waren stets positiv in Kontakt mit dem Besitzer und der Check-in lief komplikationslos ab, da wir spät angekommen sind. Auf Nachrichten wurde schnell reagiert und sie waren auch hilfreich. Wir waren im 3. und auch im letzten Stock der Wohnung. Die Stahltür machte einen sicheren Eindruck und die Treppen fühlten sich nicht allzu hoch an bis zum 3. Stock.
Es gab keine Probleme und die Wohnung war ordentlich und sauber! Die Lichter im Zimmer waren gut verteilt und die Vorhänge dunkelten das Zimmer auch gut ab! Ab und zu hatten wir draußen Geräusche gehört aber es war eine ruhige Straße. Uns war wichtig der Bahnstation nah und dennoch zentral zu sein. Es war ein 3 Minuten Weg zur Station Sirkeci und dort fangen auch schon Restaurants, Läden und change offices etc. an.
Gerne wieder!

Bizden önceki konaklamadan sonra çıkış işlemi, temizlik , çarşaf değişimi yapılmamıştı Mehmet beye yazdığımız da direkt olarak geri dönüş sağladı ve hızlı şekilde sorunumuzu çözdü . Konum olarak gayet iyi Marmara’ya-Tramvaya yakın.

description:
Located on the historical peninsula, right next to the Aya Kiryaki Church, this 3-story detached house stands out with its special decoration and historical living area that bears the traces of the past.

You can walk to Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia and the Grand Bazaar. Each room has air conditioning, a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed internet and a dryer.

It offers a living space in the heart of Istanbul that is completely yours.

reviews.text:
This place saved us. We had a family of 12 that booked a hotel that was awful so we had to find a home last minute. The house was not bad. We had some concerns from other reviews but they answered all our questions quickly.
Enes even showed us the house in person and was very helpful with anything we needed.
We were comfortable and had very few complaints.
The stairs are a bit small and you need to duck down to go upstairs.
They have a washer and dryer that was very helpful. And all the things we wanted to do were walking distance away! It was the best location. Very good price for the amount of rooms and beds you have.
I recommend this place for the location and helpfulness of the owners. They saved our family and we all had an enjoyable time!

it is a spacious place as described and it is in a great location. Had a comfortable stay, clean bathrooms/kitchen/bedrooms. Many many restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies, bakery and shopping in walkable distance. Easy to find taxis/cars to get around. Mix of tourists and locals in the area. We felt safe around here and would highly recommend this place.

We had a wonderful stay. The accommodation was ideal for our large multigenerational family, with plenty of space for everyone to relax comfortably.
The hosts were excellent throughout. They were welcoming, polite, and always quick to respond whenever we had a question.
The location was one of the highlights. It was within easy reach of major attractions, restaurants, supermarkets, and local amenities, while still feeling like a genuinely traditional neighbourhood. Staying here gave us a real sense of everyday life in Istanbul rather than just the tourist experience. Waking up to the call to prayer each day was especially memorable.
There were plenty of affordable local shops and excellent places to eat nearby. We particularly enjoyed Baba’s for its vegan options, and there were also some fantastic dessert cafés offering high quality treats at very reasonable prices.
We would happily stay here again and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul, especially larger famili

We stayed at this unique three-floor home with a basement, and overall it was a very memorable experience. The property is quite large, with six bedrooms, which made it a great private space for a group like ours. It felt quiet, safe, and perfect for spending time together.
One of the biggest highlights is the location—it’s excellent. Everything you might need is within walking distance, including grocery stores, restaurants, small local markets, and even a playground for kids. We also loved being able to walk to nearby beautiful landmarks and traditional places of worship (mosques), which added a special cultural charm to the stay, especially in Turkey.
The home also has a small, charming balcony that we really enjoyed. It was a lovely spot to relax, have coffee, and take in the surroundings.
That said, there were a couple of downsides. The kitchen is quite small for a larger group, and the dining table wasn’t very comfortable. Since there were eight of us, it felt a bit cramped wh

Great Airbnb for a big group in Istanbul
We stayed here for 6 days with a group of 10 and the place worked really well for us. The house was clean, spacious enough for everyone, and overall a solid choice for a large group of friends.
The only minor downsides: there are two bathrooms in the basement and just one on the second floor, so mornings could get a bit busy. The wooden floors also make the house a little squeaky when people walk around.
That said, these were small issues compared to how well the space fit our group. Clean, comfortable, and practical for a bigger party. Would happily recommend it to anyone traveling with friends or a larger group.

description: This studio with a private rooftop and Galata view is perfect for romantic getaways or creative minds. Enjoy your romantic moments while watching the sunset from a peaceful city escape.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Bahat’s penthouse loft for four nights. The location is unbeatable. Just half a block from the T1 tram that takes you to all of the famous sights. It is also super close to Galata Tower, good walk but very much uphill.
The place was super clean and the bathroom and washer worked perfectly. There’s a really lovely terrace right above you and while I’m sure other guests could use it, it felt like our own.
The view is amazing. You’re on the European side looking directly at Asia. Bahat was also very gracious with recommendations for a hamam and even let us check out a little later and hold our luggage until it was time to go to the airport.
The only thing you should know is that there is no elevator, so it’s five flights of winding stairs. Totally doable if you’re in decent shape, but still 100% worth the space. Internet connection was strong and consistent.
It will be somewhere we would love to stay again!

Bahat is an amazing host and the place is at a very convenient location with stunning view with 3 side windows and we were lucky to get the yop floor. Only challange was to climb the narrow stairs upto the top floor but it was no problem with us, we sre light travellers. If you are travelling with big suitcase, might worth consider checking your floor. Overall, the place looks beautiful with nice pictures on the wall, makes you feel right at home and cozy with a view of Galata. Very close to the tram station Tophane.
The location is perfect, just as described and felt comfortable. The host always answer fast and made recommendations, everything on top.

I have stayed in three different airbnbs in the area and this was by far my favorite. The view and terrace are incredible!!!! Seriously! The only thing is be sure you read that it is on the fifth floor and there is no elevator. For us this was no problem, and so worth it for the view!!! Very comfortable room and very helpful host. Will absolutely be staying here again on my next trip to Istanbul!

We had a great stay! The apartment is small but very cozy and in very good condition. Everything was clean and comfortable. The location is excellent and very convenient, with easy access to everything we needed. The host was very welcoming and helpful. Thank you for the hospitality, staying here made our trip even more enjoyable!

Evde ihtiyacınız olabilecek her şeyden fazla fazla vardı. tuz , baharat , Kahve, çöp poşeti , ıslak mendil, bakım kitleri,havuz için havlu ,duş için havlu , göz bandı ve tek kullanımlık terlikler gibi. ev sahipleri ulaşılabilirlik açısından çok iyiydi. eksik olarak söyleyebileceklerim perde yoktu ışık açık olunca dışarıdan içerisi gözüküyor. banyoda havlu asmak için askı yok. biraz tozluydu. çöp kovası yoktu. saat konusunda oldukça esnek ve yardımseverdiler. bir daha gider miyim diye sorarsanız kesinlikle giderim . reviews.text:
Unfortunately, our stay was disappointing. We stayed for five days, and the apartment was not at all what we expected based on the photos.
The apartment was booked for 4 people, but there was only 3 fork and only 3 dining chairs. There were no cooking pots at all, and the kitchen equipment in general was very limited and quite old. I messaged the host asking for a pot because we needed one for basic cooking. He replied that he would provide one, but it was never delivered.
The condition of the apartment was also much worse than it appeared in the photos. Some of the walls were damaged and deteriorated, and the flooring was badly worn or damaged in several areas.
There was a dishwasher and washing machine, but no basic supplies were provided. I would at least expect one dishwasher tablet for the first day.
Overall, the apartment felt poorly maintained and not properly equipped for four guests.
Good point is location, but we used mostly Uber during our stay.
