Most importantly, it was spotless—everything was extremely clean and tidy, including the bedsheets, bathroom, kitchen utensils, and appliances. Everything worked perfectly throughout my stay.
The neighborhood is lovely, friendly, and full of character. There is also an embassy nearby, which made the area feel especially safe, as well as a great bar on the ground floor. Although there can be music from downstairs, the bedroom windows are well soundproofed, so it did not affect my stay.
Overall, this is a beautiful, comfortable, and exceptionally clean apartment with wonderful hosts. I would definitely recommend it!

We had a great stay overall. Communication with the host was excellent—very responsive and proactive throughout. They were also flexible with check-in, allowing us to arrive early with just 30 minutes’ notice, which made things very convenient.
The location was ideal, with easy access to everywhere we needed to go. The apartment itself was spacious, clean, and well-equipped with all the essentials. We also appreciated the welcome basket with snacks—a nice touch. The place stayed warm at all times, and having free access to heating was a big plus. The building itself is full of character, being around 150 years old, which added to the experience.
The only downside was the noise from the Irish pub located directly downstairs. Music could be quite loud and continued until around 3am, which may be an issue for light sleepers. There were also a few minor unfinished details in the apartment, such as some exposed or loose pipes.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it.

We were a group of seven people, and we stayed at GG’s for 9 nights. The place was exactly as described, clean, and at a great location. The hosts were friendly and responsive, always trying to help.
Regarding the noise issue that everyone mentions, the noise from the bar downstairs IS audible, and lasts until around 3AM, however, it WILL NOT disturb sleeping, unless you are super sensitive to it. My dad is a light sleeper, and he had no problems.
The only thing that I can recommend to the hosts, is to invest a little more on the household equipment. Everything technically “works”, and there is everything one could need (even a clothes dryer!), but some things are not the best quality, or are barely working.
Overall, we were VERY satisfied with our stay there, and I definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful stay! Everything was great — the neighborhood, the house, and all the amenities provided. The home was very clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The host was incredibly kind, helpful, and responsive throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this place to others. Thank you for such a great experience!

Konaklamam çok keyifliydi. Bırakılan şarap ve atıştırmalıklar için çok teşekkür ederim. Gece yorgun bir şekilde konaklamama vardığımda harika hissettim. Ev tam da fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi çok güzel, özenle tasarlanmış, ihtiyacım olabilecek her şey düşünülmüş ve tertemizdi. Tam bir yoga düşkünü olduğumdan, spor malzemelerinin bulunması harikaydı. Akşam sanki kendi evimdeymiş gibi yemek yapıp arkadaşlarımı ağırladım. Duvarda asılı hem gezi, hemde yemek mekanı tavsiyeleri özenle hazırlanmıştı, böyle bir listeyi internette bulmanız bile zor, çok işime yaradı. Ses konusunda başta endişe etmiştim ama yaşayan bir şehrin müziğini balkonda bir kadeh şarapla dinlemek çok güzel bir deneyimdi, camları kapattığımda ise tüm gürültü dışarda kaldı. En kısa zamanda tekrar ; bu sefer daha kalabalık bir şekilde bu çok geniş ve rahat evde konaklamak istiyorum.

description:
Very silent and calm location. Warm in winter, cool in summer. Building is new.
Central place. By public transport, you can reach Kadıköy and Besiktas in 20 minutes, Taksim and Sultan Ahmet in 30 minutes, Levent in 40 minutes.

reviews.text:
+ responsive host
+ dedicated workspace
+ exercise area
+ light room
- not very clean. Woman hair on the floor
- noise from the neighbors
- there were someone else's private things in the apartment (clothes, food, photos...)
- the apartment needs some cosmetic renovation (the toilet is leaking, taking a shower created a puddle..)

Fatih was so nice and helpful with checkin, during our stay and especially check out that he made it flexible for us to check out later than the schedule. Besides, it was really good to talk to him and personally he was so friendly, nice, kind and communicative.
The place was overall nice with some unexpected points. First of all, I never though that during the winter I can see mosquitoes in the house. This was so annoying despite the protective actions we did like closing all the windows. And second, the place was a bit noisier than I expected.
At the end, I need to mention that the stay was nice, within 10 min walk you can reach waterside(a bit steepy) and some shops like supermarkets are also close by.
Thank you Fatih for your helps and I would recommend the place.

Great place for long term rental in the heart of Istanbul. Easy to check-in due to detailed instructions. Very spacious, light and warm apartment, have all necessary amenities and furniture. No TV and dishwasher, but it wasn't a problem. Area is calm and peaceful close to Baglarbasi metro and Uskudar pier. Wifi stable and fast. Fatih is responsive host always in touch and ready to help. Thank you! We would be glad to stay here again.
Quiet and peaceful location, if you want to get taste of real Istanbul, go for it. Metro and bus station, mall and coffeeshops in around 10 minutes walking.
Fatih is a very responsive and polite person. This is a great place to stop in Istanbul!

description:
My cozy 2-bedroom apartment is old in style but kept clean and fully functional. Centrally located in a safe neighborhood, it has everything you need for both short and long stays at a great price/value. Enjoy
self check-in and check-out for a hassle-free experience.

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant stay. The apartment is a bit older and could use some maintenance, but it was very clean, decently equipped, and in a very central location. We were pleasant with our stay, especially considering the price. If you are looking for a luxury experience, this might not be the right fit, but it is a good value option for a comfortable stay.
Denizhan was very helpful, flexible, and provided great recommendations throughout our stay. We appreciated his hospitality.

We had a great stay overall. The location is excellent very central, with plenty of great restaurants, cafés, and supermarkets just a short walk away. The neighborhood also felt safe, quiet, and pleasant. Denizhan was a very helpful and responsive host throughout our stay, which made everything easy. The apartment could use a bit of maintenance in some areas, but considering the price, it offers excellent value for money. It met our expectations, and we would definitely consider staying here again.

I had a wonderful stay at Denizhan’s place. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a pleasant stay. Denizhan was a great host and made the whole experience easy and enjoyable. I’d definitely recommend staying here and would be happy to come back!
Fiyat performans deneyimiydi. Konumu mükemmel.
Tatlı, huzurlu, kendi evimizde gibi hissettiğimiz temiz, düzenli, güzel konumda bir evdi teşekkür ederiz

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text:
Loved this stay in Beyoğlu, just a short walk to Galata Tower. The location made it easy to explore Karaköy, the Bosphorus, and nearby spots on foot. Even though the area can get busy, the unit is well soundproofed, so it stays quiet and comfortable inside.
The place was clean, cozy, and perfect to come back to after a full day out.
Duygu was a great host. Responsive, clear with instructions, and easy to deal with.
I’d happily stay here again. Love from Malaysia 🇲🇾
Very good location, the place complies with what is described in the photos, and the host is always attentive to help

We had such a lovely stay in Istanbul, and a huge part of that was because of our amazing host, Duygu. She is genuinely one of the sweetest and most welcoming Airbnb hosts I have ever met. From the moment we arrived, she made us feel so comfortable and at home. It honestly felt less like staying at an Airbnb and more like visiting family.
She was incredibly kind, helpful and always quick to respond whenever we needed anything. She also gave us great recommendations for restaurants and places to visit in Istanbul.
Even though our stay was quite short, it was such a warm and memorable experience. The location of the Airbnb was also perfect. It felt very local and lively, with so much to do nearby, and everything was easy to reach by public transport. The streets leading to the Airbnb are definitely quite steep, but honestly that didn’t take away from our experience at all.
We truly loved staying here and felt so welcomed throughout our entire stay.
Would 100% stay again❤️
oda cok rahat ve temizdi ev sahibi duygu hanım cok enerjik ve tatlı bir kadındı kesinlikle tavsiye ederim

Cam açık durmak imkansız çok ses vardı ve masa yoktu yemeğimizi kucağımızda yatakta yedik son çare mecbur yatak yanındaki küçük komodini kullanmak zorunda kaldık. Bir daha tercih etmem fakat amaç dinlenmek değilse gezmekse evet tercih edilir çünkü merkezi bir konum her yere çok yakın.

description:
Our apartment is on the 2nd floor of a grand and elegant 19th century building very close to Galata Tower. It's stylish, spacious, graceful and airy, with stunning views right across the Golden Horn from the shared roof terrace a few floors up.

We also offer a selection of 'experiences' with our local guides, to help you build your own genuine and memorable perspective on the city.

reviews.text:
Location cannot be best. Best location possible.
Check in and communication couldn’t have been easier.
But the apartment and the building are just ok. The building is old. The apartment is comfortable enough but looks much better in the pictures.
The bathroom was dark and needed a bit of work and had odor issues that was clearly something that has happened before. Strong sulfur smell had to checkout early because it was absolutely unbearable. Owners were very quick to comply with the early checkout which was very appreciated.
Bedrooms were clean and comfortable.
WiFi reached only in the living room/dining room it didn’t extend to the bedrooms.
Maybe our expectations were too high for the price.

While others appear to have had a great experience ours unfortunately was not good as it was riddled with problems. Taskin (the hosts representative) was always very responsive but he never actually solved any of the issues. Following our stay when we reported our list of problems to the hosts they completely ignored us - not a single email.
We stayed for 2 nights and here were our Issues:
1. On our second night the Carbon Monoxide alarm went off due to an issue with the water heater - according to Taskin, apparently this has happened before. The proposed solution was to remove to CO alarm rather than fix the hot water heater that issues the CO and causes the alarm. They did not fix the issue while we were there but advised they would fix it after we left. Given how lethal CO poisoning can be, this was a major concern for us and we do not think Taskin and the team understand how deadly it can be or took it seriously given this is a recurring issue.
2. The AC in 1 of the bedrooms did not work properly and stopped working both nights. This was due to two separate issues. (the first issue I had to find a temporary fix when they could not fix it in the light of day, the second issue they said they would "fix in the morning" - when we were due to check out
3. Washing machine jammed and locked with clothes inside on two separate occasions and required 10 minutes of a physical struggle by Taskin to open - after 2 weeks traveling in Africa we needed to use this and were effectively unable to.
4. Smell of sewage was in apartment. We were told by Taskin this was probably due to a leak a few days earlier and the smell would "go away in a few days after it dries out". I see someone else complained about this in a review - I can assure you when we were a guest the odor was strong.
If I had to be picky, I would add that the roof top is far less inviting than the picture makes it look - the furniture is worn and much of it is broken (the view is accurate however). The apartment itself is accurate but it photographs better than reality. It gets limited sun and has no view as it is on the 2nd floor and all windows face very narrows streets, the buildings around and opposite are all 5+ stories.
Given the price point of the apartment and this number of issues. It is simply not good enough. As such I could not recommend this apartment unless it was significantly cheaper. IMO it is a solid 2 star hotel equivalent.

Spacious apartment with a fantastic terrace and beautiful views directly across from Galata Tower. The hosts were responsive, and the location is convenient to shops, cafés, and the city center.
However, the bathroom was a major drawback. There is only one bathroom, and it had a persistent sewage-like odor throughout our stay. The shower could have been cleaner, and an opened bottle of used shampoo was left on the floor. Only toilet paper was provided, though clean towels were available.
The building is very old with filthy stairs, noise from pigeons and cats, and the surrounding area can feel uncomfortable early in the morning. The streets are also crowded and difficult to navigate with luggage.
Great terrace and location, but overall we would only recommend it for a short stay and would not personally return to this specific apt for sanitation standards.
Thanks for the stay.

This spacious apartment is ideally located. It was sparkling clean and provided plenty of living space for five of us. Tarkan was a fantastic host meeting us upon arrival and always available for questions. A few important highlights! Amazing hot water with great water pressure. The apartment has AC which was key as it’s warm in July. The views from the roof were breathtaking.
The location is perfect though you should be in good shape given the incline you climb from the tram to the Galata Tower. Also note the apartment requires two flights of stairs to climb too.
I would return to this apartment again for any future visits.
Lastly, issues raised in a previous review were not experienced at all in any way.

The Good: Unbeatable location, right next to Galata Tower! Close to tram and metro station, walking distance to Taskim Square. The place fits 6-7 people nicely: comfy beds, powerful AC, well equipped kitchen with a dish washer and washing machine. Tarkan and Julia are amazing hosts, and their local team is well coordinated and responsive. The have their own site where you can book anything from airport transfers to private tours. They will also provide a metro/tram/ferry card which was very useful to move around the city. The manager will personally welcome you at check in and pick up the keys at check out (very convenient!).
The bad: Wifi only reaches the living room, but not the rooms...
The only disappointment was the terrace. We were aware that it was a shared terrace for the building, but were expecting it to at least have a nice table and chairs like shown in the picture. The view is indeed great, but the space could use some furniture....
Overall, would definitively recommend and stay again!

description: Our flat is in the same building and on the same floor as our other listing (Galata Charm) which has over 100 reviews approving its comfort, design and our hospitality. Now this is a a more compact flat, again beautifully decorated.. And for higher security of our guests, the flat is equipped with an alarm system.

reviews.text:
The apartment of Idil is one of the best airbnbs I've stayed at. It is spacious, equipped with everything you need and provides an Istanbul flair right away.
- Location: It is located in a small street next to the Galata tower, very central and the metro was a quick hike away. Istanbul is a hilly city, so be prepared to walk up hill and down dale. The apartment is located in the 3rd floor and has no elevator, but walking up the marble stairs had a charm on its own.
- CheckIn: Check in was smooth and it was described thoroughly by Idil how to enter the apartment and where to find the keys. You get two keys: one for entering the building and one for the apartment. Be careful and do not force the lock, both keys do fit in both doors, but only one opens it.
- Apartment: the accomodation is well equipped. There are a lot of towels (more than you will need), enough bedding and the kitchen has everything you need (oil, salt, pepper). Even though there is a french press and a drip coffee maker, coffee was not provided and has to be bought from the store. Furthermore the street is narrow and it was possible to see every detail of the neighbours. However, there were shutters on the windows and I had the general feeling that privacy is respected and that you did not have to feeling to be watched even though the neighbors could. Opening the windows for fresh air was a bit of a challenge, because they are heavy and old. In my oppinion the only flaw is the wifi speed. It could be a bit faster.
- Communication: Idil responded right away to each of our wishes and requests. We were even able to check out late on our last day, as ther was no booking right after ours. Just ask politely :)
Atogether it was a very pleasent stay and I would recommend Idils apartment. You can look forward to this place. Be aware that the accomodation is historic and old. There might be things like creaking floors, which should not bother you.

Great location - literally steps away from Galata Tower with many shops and restaurants nearby + walking distance to Istiklal Avenue which is a really wonderful street to walk/shop/eat/people-watch
The apartment is also really spacious with 3 bedrooms, a toilet, living area, kitchen, dining area - it isn't the cleanest apartment we have been to, but it is understandable since the cleaner only has a few hours in between check-out and check-in to clean the huge apartment
One thing to note is that the apartment is located on the 4th floor, so you will have to climb quite a few flights of stairs to reach the Airbnb

This is being written by Maureen’s partner. I erroneously booked it under Maureen’s account and Idil was nice enough to honor it anyway
This unit is very large and quite charming. A mix of old and new. We loved the floors and the walls with stucco on brick. It is a very old building but with good power, WiFi, etc. The location cannot be better if you want to be near Galata tower which is a fun area. It is near everything.
Be aware that this is a location uphill from almost everywhere and is a fourth floor apartment without a lift. However, all three of us were over 70 and this didn’t bother us. The staircase is old and worn and we actually enjoyed going up and down. Once you are there, you will find that going to the area near the metro stop is much easier than climbing the hilly roads. So not a problem once you are there
We really liked the unit but it needs upgraded furniture to be a 5 star. If you use all three bedrooms, the sofa is in one bedroom. Dining table is way to small. I am sure Idil can correct this.
There is an excellent washer and competent kitchen. Super clean sheets and towels. Good shower and bathroom.

This was my first airbnb experience and i was very hesitant about it. It was an EXCELLENT choice that we made by choosing Idil's home. The flat had every thing that a traveler needs. The flat is clean, fresh, and had a full kitchen, hot water in shower and bathroom and kitchen. Idil had water in the fridge of us as well as fresh fruits. She was very helpful with all our questions about travel in Turkey.
The flat is in an amazing location. You take a step to your left and then there is fresh squeezed orange juice and a fruit stall. A lovely place to eat just next to Galata tower called Gunny that I recommend. You take a few minutes walk and you enter the famous Taqsim square.
You go right and you can walk to Sultan Ahmed area. It took us about 40 minutes to walk.
There is also an Austrian Hospital near by that my sister and I needed and was a great quick prompt service.
I HIGHLY recommend Idil's place. We are planning on coming back in the winter.

Idil's flat is a great base for any visit to Istanbul. The location is amazing, in the heart of one of the most vibrant and exciting areas of the city, with easy access to everything. The space itself is very comfortable and extremely tasteful, with great touches. Everything was clean, the furniture was comfortable and the AC worked wonderfully. Idil was quick to respond to any questions and went out of her way to be helpful. I would highly recommend this flat, and Idil as a host.

description: It is a place where you can enjoy the silence and fresh air very close to the center of Büyükada. It is surrounded by greenery with its large garden and common areas. There are equipment at home to meet your needs. We can rent for at least 100 days.

reviews.text: Great apartment, very spacy. Has everything you need, literally. The host was helpful. The only issue is there is no wifi whatsoever, which host compensated by a discount. Generally will recommend this place.

Sadece Büyükada'da değil, adaların en güzel evi diyebiliriz. Gözünüz kapalı tutabilirsiniz. Konum, temizlik, huzur... Mutlu ayrıldım. Bir sonraki İstanbul yolculuğumda tekrardan tutacağım yer. Teşekkürler.
What a lovely place. Felt like home right away. The place is much better than in the photos.
Ev cok rahat, temiz ve merkezi. Ayrica Kerim de cok yardimci oluyor.
Kerim harika bir ev sahibi evin konumu guzel sonraki seyahetlerimde kararsizca tercih edebilirim tum sorularima sabirli bir sekilde cevap verdi hersey icin tesekkurler.

description:
TR/ENG

Our facility has five apartments and three different types of rooms.

Apartment 5 is on the top floor and is a 1+1 Suite room with a balcony. Apartments 4 and 3 are on the middle floor, we have two studio rooms, and finally, on the ground floor, we have two 1+1 reverse duplex rooms.

Our room in this profile is a 1+1 spacious luxury furnished room with a large balcony on the top floor.

It is a 3-minute walk to the coast of Ortaköy and transportation is easy.

reviews.text: The flat is well located in a quiet street but near restaurants, cafés, bus and vapur stops. It was very clean and as described. The AC in the bedroom was most welcomed ! The balcony was so nice and the neighbourhood is warm and welcoming, not too touristy. We had a great time during our stay!

It's my first time in Turkey. I was lucky that found Authentic Turkish Home. Before make reservation I needed ask several questions and Mert responded quickly. From airport to Istanbul I was stuck in a traffic. Mert patiently waited for my arrival. About hotel I stayed on 3rd floor 1 bedroom with kitchen and very cute balcony. Everywhere clean and nice apartment. Mert advised few restaurants in the neighborhood which located 2 blocks away and whole street full of cozy, beautiful restaurants. Prices are not expensive and delicious foods especially breakfasts. My favorite restaurant was Ortakoy Firini good thing about this restaurant they have bakery too. Till Bosphorus 10 min walk from hotel. There is too a lot of restaurants and gift shops. My last day I had to go to the airport and Mert offered to order a taxi. And it was a large and comfortable minivan. I arrived at the airport with great comfort. In the end, I would like to recommend this Hotel. Mert thank you very much for your help and hospitality.

Cozy and warm, clean and comfortable apartment on the top (third) floor of a nice townhouse in a happening neighborhood. From the many terraced pubs at the edge of the Bosphorus Strait that is a few minutes' walk from the apartment, you can see the ancient Ortaköy Mosque and the Bosphorous Bridge. Buses are nearby and run frequently, but the area is prone to traffic jams, so don't rely on the schedule too much. A trip to Sultanahmet usually involves a bus and a tram and takes about 30 min. Taxis are cheap and plentiful, but also get stuck in traffic, so trams and metro are often faster. If you are there for several days, get the Istanbul Kart - you can top it up with any amount and use it for all public transport (buses, trams, metro). We left two of those cards on the table - perhaps they are still there ;)
There is also a great park a few minutes walk from the apartment. If the weather is nice, you can visit some palaces there and have a picnic.
The host is very responsive and takes care of the guests. We highly recommend him, his hotel and the location.
Martin & Joanna
(Poland)

The home was indeed beautiful and as described. However, the place is quite small and could be uncomfortable for people who prefer spacious rooms.
The location is excellent and in a quiet neighborhood of Ortakoy. There are decent and affordable restaurants and taxis nearby. It is also quite close to a cruise point for Bosphorus, Kumpir shops etc. Mert was always available and responded to our issues at the earliest. We were here during summer so that place felt quite stuffed up (there is no AC and ventilation is not great especially while sleeping).
Also never had an issue with getting taxis to this place.

Bora’s place is exactly as described in the listing! Super cozy, great location, surrounded by good restaurants & a vibrant atmosphere in the Ortaköy neighborhood of Istanbul.
Would recommend to anyone looking for a walkable location.
Definitely would stay here again!
Bora was a great host, always responsive & can provide local suggestions for just about anything you may want to do!

description:
{ More Quality of Living }
Enjoy a stylish experience at centrally-located spacious flat.
taking our time to perfectly furnish this place to offer a unique memorable holiday to you, your family & friends
Living at this place will offer a cosmopolitan experience like no other!

We proudly hosted more than 1000 guests in the last 4 years in multiple central locations in Istanbul, therefore we are aware of your needs and expectations to make it a unique, unforgettable, and comfortable experience!

reviews.text: We have a great stay in Nael’s place. Nael is a lovely host and responds quickly to any issues you might have. The apartment was clean, warm and cosy. Lovely comfortable bed. The shower pressure was great, the hot and cold temperature in the shower could be a little erratic. You can get into Taksim by walk super quick and access local places to visit. A great pizza place was Antique Pizzeria in Taksim and Authentic Persian restaurant Reyhan 5 minutes walk from the apartment. I suggest using maps so you don’t make mistakes like we did a couple of times and got a little lost. There is a 5th Century Mosque nearby which can wake you up with call to come and prayer. I can highly recommend this apartment and if we stay in the area again I would book this apartment.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was very convenient. The host was friendly and responsive, making check-in and communication very easy. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area and would be happy to stay here again.

Everything was perfect! The host was incredibly helpful, kind, and trustworthy, making our stay completely stress-free. They assisted us with everything we needed and ensured a smooth experience. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I highly recommend it and would love to stay here again! Thank you for everything.

Great apartment for a few nights in Istanbul, I really enjoyed my staying here. The room is very spacious and clean, there is everything that is needed in the bathroom and kitchen. My check-in was comfortable and went smoothly. Perfect accommodation for a great price.

Ev ulaşması kolay bir konumda bulunmaktadır. Şu ana kadar gördüğüm en temiz Airbnb evlerinden biriydi. Ev sahibi gün içinde sürekli bize yardımcı oldu. Ev fotoğraflardakinin aynısıydı. Ev ile ilgili olumsuz olabilecek tek şey duşta suyun sıcaklığının ayarlanmasının zor olmasıydı. Bir anda sıcak veya soğuk olabiliyordu. Geriye kalan her konuda ise bir Airbnb evinde olmasını beklediğiniz her şey mevcuttu. Ev sahibine ilgisinden ötürü teşekkür ederiz.

description:
This is a studio flat containing one bedroom and living room monolithically.
It's industrial design, mostly woodwork furniture , floor, functional space usage makes the flat joyful.
You can enjoy the original sauna .
The elevator is a unique feature.
The ceiling high windows capture the daylight in the most perfect way.

reviews.text: Özra's apartment is so spacious, good water pressure, always hot water, filterd drinking water and privet sauna in the apartment. Bed was comfortable, clean and plenty of extra linens. Washer in apartment. The kitchen has plenty of utensils to cook. There are many windows that can be opened and let air and sun light come in. I stayed during winter and the heat system kept the apartment very comfortable. There is a small elevator that opens into the apartment. Great location near public transportation, local shops, restaurants and grocery stores. Things to consider: Due to the location the weekend nights can be noisy, I am a light sleeper and I was able to sleep well. Wood floors can be squeaky, but the apartment is on the top floor so there is no one above you. Overall it is a great stay and Özra is very friendly and helpful.

Thank you Ozra for the lovely stay! The studio matches the photos pretty accurately, in addition there are more curtains to separate the studio, which is always nice.
The location is very convenient to anyone who wants to explore the sights, everything is pretty much in walkable distance and I am sure you will love to stay here!
However, the sauna wasn't hot enough to keep us warm in the rainy cold weather, but still was very much appreciated.
Note that the neighbourhood is kinda noisy in the evenings and nights till around 2-3 am, especially during the weekend. So if you are a sensitive sleeper, we would recommend bringing a pair of earplugs with you :)
The hot water wasn't an issue (we had a poor experience before), although it wasn't easy to set up the right temperature.
Overall, a good place to stay in Istanbul, Ozra is definitely an excellent host, but maybe worth if you stay for shorter period of time or with a group of 3 or 4 people to cover expenses.

For the most part this is a great AirBnB. The studio is very spacious and stylish. The area is great for bars and restaurants and is within a few minutes walk to the Galata tower. Ozra was very friendly, helpful and responsive in all her communications including offering an early check-in and keeping me updated over a local issue with the water supply. The apartment is well stocked and clean. Unfortunately there are some downsides which prevent me from giving 5 stars. There is one AC unit at the far end of the studio which is very ineffective. There is an additional celling fan above the bed, but the result is that the sleeping area gets very hot at night, even during Spring temperatures. The ceiling fan is also quite noisy and in addition you can hear noise from local bars at night. Also the mattress is quite uncomfortable. As such if you are a light sleeper the above conditions could be problematic. If such things do not bother you then I can highly recommend Ozra's place.

This AirBnB experience was the best I ever had!
Özra is a very polite and quick responding host, who cares about the guests' comfort and well-being. She answers to every message within 2 minutes. It cannot be stressed enough how helpful Özra has been throughout our trip.

As the flat is located nearby the Galata Tower it is in the middle of the center of the European part of Istanbul and everything important like supermarket and metro station can be reached quickly by feet.
The flat is very clean, big and looks like a interior designer has done her work perfectly. With a big space, every necessary equipment and an oven, the kitchen offers you everything you need to cook at home. The highlight of this AirBnB is the sauna, which gives you warm moments during some rainy and cold days in Istanbul.
All in all I would stay again at this wonderful place including a fantastic host and recommend it also to everybody, who wants to visit the capital city of Turkey.

This place is one of the trendiest and convenient places I have ever stayed at.
My stay was short but it was sweet! The apartment is located in a central location with metro 2 minutes away, it is secure with night time police right out front monitoring the area which was very comforting.
The place is located very close to all the hotspots in Beyoğlu and amazing cocktail bars and restaurants. The hosts have styled it incredibly well with an industrial-like feel, the apartment is big in size and photos did absolutely no justice, it was more than I expected and I will definitely be staying again.
The hosts are also extremely helpful and friendly, I definitely recommend to anyone wanting the true Istanbul experience. Can get a bit noisy from all the bars, but that’s the beauty of being right smack in all of the liveliness.

description: Garden house with covered deck in a quiet area of Kadikoy with underground parking. Located 15 minutes to the lively centre of Kadikoy (Kadife Street). Go to Moda to enjoy trendy cafes, alternative shops and art galleries. Have a cup of tea in front of the sea in Fenerbahçe Park, Kalamis Park or Moda Park, which are also close. Shopping in the market (çarsi) is 15 minutes away. Also very easy to cross to the European side with the ferry boat or the underground, only 25 minutes away.

reviews.text: Laurent was a very nice person. He responsed for all our questions promptly. Home was exactly the same as you can see in its stylish photos. All details in home was very good and you can find many kitchen tools to prepare your dishes, if you plan for long stay. It was very clean and also didn't lose its warmness. It was a pleasure for us to stay at this home. If you are looking somewhere which deserves its price please conslder that option as well.

A beautiful place with a perfect location in Kadıköy. Laurent is very helpful and he is so kind. House was clean. There was every tool that you might need in a kitchen. Garden is so relaxing, you can escape the noise of the Istanbul in there. You should try it.

This was a great stay. My wife and I stayed at Laurent's apartment for 1 month. We were working during the evenings/nights and during the day we would go out and walk around Kadikoy & Moda, or travel to the european side to visit the main tourist spots.
The apartment is shown 100% accurate in the listing. The wifi is great, and it has everything that you need to be comfortable. The kitchen is well equipped.
There location is amazing. It's about 45-55 minutes from the main tourist places like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Taksim Square, Galata Tower. You can easily travel there from the apartment using the metro (10 minute walk to the station) or by ferry (15 minute walk to station).
The area surrounding the aparment is also great. It's located in a very quiet street, ideal for resting at night. But you can walk a few blocks and find great restaurants, backeries, coffee shops, etc. It's also a great location to walk to the shore and enjoy the view of the ocean.
Definitely would stay here again!

Located in the heart of vibrant, colourful Kadikoy and an easy walk to two convenient metro stations and the ferry ports, this was a wonderful place to stay for a first (but not last) visiting Istanbul.
The flat was immaculately clean and stylish but also spacious and comfortable. We both felt very relaxed and at home staying there and made our time in Istanbul all the more enjoyable knowing we had somewhere safe and quiet to return to after a busy day exploring the city.
Laurent was always available if needed and incredibly helpful in offering advice such as where to get the best groceries in the neighbourhood (freshly baked bread from the lovely Kinoko is highly recommended by us both now).
Highly recommended. We will definitely be back!

Beautiful apartment and brand new amenities as shown in the pictures. Comfortable, and spotless.
Kitchen is very well equipped, you will find everything you need and more to cook.
I was traveling with my 2 month old son, and we were provided with a travel style baby cot and a baby bath.
Neighborhood is perfect, because the apartment is located in a quiet street but only 100 mts away from all type of shops ( supermarket, pharmacy, etc).
I would highly recommend the place, specially in summer, to enjoy the lovely garden.

description: Our hotel is 10-15 minutes walking distance to Sultanahmet Square. It is a cute and stylish place in the historical peninsula. Hagia Sophia museum, Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Basilica Palace, Topkapi Palace and many other historical places are within walking distance. We will be proud to welcome you.

reviews.text: The pictures are accurate. Room is clean and bed space is perfect for big families. Kitchen is basic with induction stove but there are many restaurants within walking distance. Streets are narrow and hilly but managable for my twin toddlers.
The place was exactly what we expected! Clean, well located and comfortable. Vefa is very kind and helpful! I really recommend his place!

Apartments are older and more broken then it looks on the photos, but in general have everything you need. In the bathroom there was only cold water in the sink, the toilet seat was very uncomfortable. Beds were comfortable. Air condition was only in the living room. in the bedroom one have to open the window otherwise it was very hot. Unfortunately under the windows were place for smoking and all the stuff from the place, their friends, guests and other people smoked and talked there around the clock. All the smoke was in our room! The district itself is very noisy and not clean although it has a special charm and proximity to attractions.

We had a great stay at Vefa's place. It is centrally located (about 10 minutes' walk from Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia), walkable to other mosques, tons of restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, as well as close to the tram, which you can easily navigate to further sites. The place is clean and the beds are comfortable. Also, Vefa is very communicative. He responds almost immediately to messages and WhatsApp. He arranged our airport transfers, advised us on money exchange, arranged our COVID tests (a technician came to us at the apartment, very easy) and arranged taxi rides to other places we wanted to visit. Highly recommend.

Our overall stay was suitable it was a last minute booking because I had surgery. Vefa was very nice, and helped with our luggage.
It’s close to grand bazaar etc but it’s like in a hilly area so you’ll be climbing very steep roads to go to all the touristic areas and back to the hotel. Not great if you had kids or are old but you won’t die if you’re young.
Pros: Towels, shampoo, soap, you can request room service for cleaning, 3 beds, toilet paper(request). They have a small kitchenette, which takes a while to cook anything stove top. There’s some pans and utensils.
Close to tourist areas. Decently clean.
Cons: You can hear foot steps of the people living in the floor on top of you. The people on top of our floor were throwing balls or something could hear it all night. To be fair, we didn’t tell Vefa because we didn’t wanna go through the hassle he maybe could’ve help us? I don’t see how though. Bathroom is verrrry small, when you turn in the faucet too hard water will flow out of the sink it’s bad engineering.

reviews.text:
The home is located very well, you can easily find and come, quite place, private veranda. Clean kitchen, all necessary things for living.
Some minuses:
-no iron (Mustafa said it was broken and no any other irons);
-washing machine didn’t work
-a lot of ants on the kitchen. Also we found 2 cockroaches;
-alone dog (quite big one) in the backyard who was barking sometimes at night (Mustafa came the second day and moved it to the front yard but the dog started to howl);
-mold in the main bedroom, so we couldn’t sleep there and had to move to the 2nd room and put 2 beds to each other

The apartment is nice and basically as described. However, we had to search for towels and a duvet (since it was quite cold). There were also some bugs and cockroaches 😒
The location is good and quiet, it was easy to get in end communication was uncomplicated.

Evin tasarımı, eşyalar, konumu bizim için oldukça iyiydi. Merkeze yaklaşık 10 dk yürüme mesafesi, önünden adabüs de geçen huzurlu bir noktada. 4 kişi gayet rahat bir şekilde konakladık. Sadece; bir akşam için terasta mangal yakıp, güzel bir masa kurup manzarayı izlemek istemiştik. O akşam evin tatlı köpeği gayet doğal bir şekilde biraz heyecanlandı ve fazla havladı. Etrafa rahatsızlık vermek istemediğimiz için biraz biz rahatsız olduk ve içeri girmek zorunda kaldık, terasın tadını pek çıkaramadık. O yüzden teras ya da bahçenin pek mangala uygun olmadığını gördük. Aynı zamanda terastaki şemsiyenin eksikliğini de özellikle güneş ve yağmurlu havada hissettik. Evdeki eşyalar yeterli ve temizdi.

4 arkadaş çok güzel iki gece geçirdik.Konum çok huzur vericiydi.Evde ihtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu. Sadece ev biraz sıcaktı klima olsa daha da iyi olurdu 🙏🏻 Ev sahibinin iletişimi iyidi.Bahçesi çok güzeldi ve fotoğraflardan daha genişti.Arka bahçede bulunan evcil dostumuz bizi hiç rahatsız etmedi aksine daha güvende hissettik kendimizi🐶teşekkür ederiz

Ev konumu ve temizliği açısından çok iyidi. Ev tüm olanakları sağlıyordu. Çok keyifli iki gün geçirdik. Ev sahibi her konuda yardımcı oldu bir sorun olduğunda hemen iletişim kurabildik. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz.

description:
Hello, Welcome to our very sunny apartment located in Kadıköy/İstanbul. To means of transport
is 5 minutes away by walking. The location is great. Kadıköy is a very active and living neihgborhood, there are lots of cafe and bars, restaurants, Turkish taverns. Which is a popular place for drinking and having fun. In moda, people are respectful and easy.Very close to Marmara university. Common areas are the bathroom and the kitchen. The room has two armchairs, one small and one big.

reviews.text:
The room is as describded. There are 4 rooms in the appartment, in one of them lives the owner Yusuf. Other 3 are for rent. we met a lot of cool people during our stay.
We stayed for a month and we would deffinetly recommend it. it's price worthy. Neighborhood is very nice, not far from Kadikoy. Yusuf is really nice and helpfull person. Gave us advice on markets, soccer fields, and even treated us with local turkish food.
As a "point to prove" I would notice a cleaning conditions in kitchen common area.Sometimes people didn't clean right away after themselves. The bathroom was always pretty clean though.
Do not expect smth luxury for a cheep price and you won't be dissapointed

Yusuf is a great host. Although I had a short stay, it was clear that he is friendly and generous he sent me clear instructions on how to find the apartment and was very helpful.
Quiet neighborhood, easy access to transportations and the internet is good.
Ev sahibi Yusuf ve Mahsuma bu güzel deneyim için teşekkürler . Ev tamda fotoğraflardaki gibi ve temizdi. Kalmak isteyen herkese öneririm

I enjoyed my stay at Mahsum’s place very much! Mahsum is a great host - always nice, responsive and helpful. The flat has friendly, creative vibes, and it has everything you may need. The location is also great - close to the heart of Kadikoy. Thank you, Mahsum!

Yusuf is a wonderful host! He explained in detail how to get to the apartment, he was always friendly and happy to help :)
The apartment is great for your budget!
Nice environment, everything you need for life, beautiful view from the window, location near the metro and grocery stores.
Would love to come here again!❤️

The place is clean, beautiful and comfortable. The air conditioner working perfect, the bed invites you to sleep.

The apartment is squeaky clean and very nice. The sheets are 5 star hotel quality and we slept like on the cloud :) You get basic kitchen amenities to cook, though the kitchen nook isn't very big. The shower is amazing, hot water and good water pressure, everything is new. The host was nice to let us stay a little after check-out time. The Internet was slow and the area gets sketchy at night. "I had a wonderful stay, even though I had to cut it short due to unexpected circumstances. The host was extremely understanding and went above and beyond to help me with a partial refund. The communication was quick and seamless, and I truly appreciated the kindness and professionalism shown. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I highly recommend staying here!

description: Completely renovated recently. High GROUND FLOOR, 45m2, 1 bedroom w. NO view, queen bed + single size sofa in living room. , water purifier, AppleTV, WiFi 100 Mbps available. Easy access to T1 tram to major historic sites (350m), 550m to Taksim and M2 metro, 700m to Kabataş ferries (to Prince's Islands, Anatolian side, Bosphorus Tours). Towels, linen and basic toiletry available as well as all listed amenities. Easy access to cafes, groceries. AC in living room only

reviews.text:
I think this is the first time I will make a negative review. The apartment is warm, the sheets and towels are clean. In this case everything is allright. BUT.
1. The apartment is on the first floor which is not obvious in the Airbnb ad. There is a ventilation hole in the window of living room. From time to time there is a smell of smoke coming inside from the streets. Besides, the cars and motorcycles that pass the street will be heard distinctly.
2. The window in the bedroom… how do I say that…leads to a dead end with a lot of trash just beside the window. In the photos the window is closed with the certain. In reality it’s a bit icreepy. You open the curtains and see…A WALL just in 50cm from your face. The wall that is 20 meters high and let’s NO LIGHT to the room at all.
3. The host includes the cleaning service that makes nearly 20% of the total price but the cleanliness of the restroom is…doubtfull.. the ceiling above the shower has rust, the walls have oily reflections here and there.
4. The boiler in the living room produces I am not exaggerating a constant noise which is disturbing. Especially at night.
The place of the apartment is no doubt an advantage. The listed points are certainly drawbacks.

Yildiray's place was nice! Description was accurate. It was clean, had everything you needed for a long term stay! The location is amazing, close to galataport and Taksim! It does get loud sometimes because it is located on the ground floor and you can hear people going up and down the elevator, etc. Other than that, this place was perfect and definitely good value! Wifi was good too, I was able to work from here without issues although wifi is the best in the living/ kitchen area!

Amazing place to stay. Great location for tourists since it is located within a walking distance to many tourist sites and to the metro station. The place is fully renovated and very clean with a contemporary feel.
The host was extremely responsive and helped me out with several different things during my stay, including providing a spare key after I was locked out within 10 minutes of contacting him. I really appreciated the good service.
I was hesitant to book this place because some reviews mentioned there is no view and the unit is dark, but I found that was not a problem for me since I was out for most of the day and only came back to sleep. Considering this unit costs half of what it would cost to book a nearby hotel, I think it's worth it even without a view and would recommend for tourists who will spend most of their time sightseeing outdoors anyways.
The neighbourhood is really safe (lots of families stay in the nearby hotels). I was not familiar with the area but felt very comfortable staying there. This place is great for a small group that wants a safe neighbourhood in a good location.
If I were to come back to Istanbul, I would definitely stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay here. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures , very nice, clean, and smelled great. It had lots of thoughtful amenities like slippers, cooking spices, and extra toilet paper. The host was responsive, and being on the first floor was convenient. In just about 6 minutes’ walk, you can reach plenty of lively and beautiful coffee shops.
On the downside, the bed was not very comfortable it had a slight slope toward the center and made noise when moving. The walls are thin, so if neighbors are loud you can hear them. The biggest issue was the main building’s door, which often got stuck; neighbors would struggle with it, and the loud metallic noise, especially at night, could wake you up.

Good:
1. The location is close to the center of the city.
2. Owner is responsive!
3. Hot water!
4. The apartment looks good!
Bad:
1. Internet speed was not good and there was no coverage in the bedroom at all.
2. The kitchen does not have some basic stuff such as a microwave and oven while in the listing description is mentioned that the apartment has an oven
3. The quality of many types of equipment in the house is too low! For example, the kettle was not working. Though he nicely changed it, the new one was not working sometimes. There was the same issue with the toilet too. The water was running after flushing!
4. The bed was not clean enough though I used my own sheets!
5. There is a big gap between the wall and the windows. That makes the apartment too cold when you are relaxing on the couch.

description:
Our apartment is located at 13th floor with the perfect city view. It is fulled with modern equipments.It is a 5-min walk from the 4. Levent stop on the Y.kapı-H.osman Metro line. You can reach Taksim and the historical peninsula in 20 min with M2 metro.It is also 1 metro stop away from areas where business centers are concentrated.It is 1 stop to Kanyon Shopping Mall and 3 stops to Cevahir Mall by metro and 10 min to İstinye Park mall by car.
It is 15 min away from the Bosphorus coast by car.

reviews.text:
Best airbnb i have stayed in!
Everything is exactly as in photos and even better in reality, it suits your stay in Istanbul regardless of its purpose. Location, view, cleanliness, accuracy, and value are all 10/10. Will definitely stay again there for future visits.

Really great stay for one to two people. Apartment was a little small but has everything you needed! Good location, close to metro and easy access to popular areas. Home was clean and great panoramic views! Building has 24/7 concierge which makes it feel safe. Bed was not the comfiest but it made do! Clear instructions from host and overall good communication.

The apartment was exactly as described, well equipped and about 5min from the metro. The view is amazing! Betul is a kind host who provided all the information upon arrival. Will definitely stay there again

Betül was an amazing host! She made sure to inform us before check in about every single detail so our self-check in was super smooth. When we need her assistance, she replied very quickly. The apartment was clean, cozy, well located (5 min walk to metro). You have everything you need in the apartment. It is a residence so there were always someone at the entrance which makes you feel safer. We recommend her apartment if you are looking for an easy access to the rets of the city and if you are looking for a modern stay. Thank you Betül 🙏

very clean, comfortable apartment, where everything is thought out to the smallest detail. Convenient location. The owner was very quick to contact and was always ready to help. I will definitely stay in the apartment again

description:
It is our apartment with the most beautiful view of Istanbul.We have thought of all your needs for our valued guests in our apartment located in the best location of Istanbul. and we look forward to providing this service to you.
Get away from the stress of daily life and live in the moment. Enjoy good food and travel and improve your sense of culture. Reward hard work and invest in the things you care about most. Right here, right now!

reviews.text: My stay at the Airbnb was comfortable and enjoyable. The place was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was friendly and responsive, making the check-in process smooth and easy. Overall, it was a pleasant experience and I would happily stay there again.

It was a great stay. Akın was very responsive and gave exact description of the place. The receptionist was also extremely helpful. The streets around the hotel are quite narrow, but he arranged a valet for parking the car. It was super easy to get around. Last but not least, the view... better than in the photos. We will definitely stay here again.
Akins place matched the pictures I saw and the area was great! It was located walking distance to taskim square. Staff was extremely helpful and accommodating!

Aynen fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Manzara müthiş ilk olarak görünenden daha çok manzara var . Konaklamamız harikaydı! Ev sahipleri çok ilgili ve yardımseverdi, her konuda destek oldular. Hem fiyat-performans açısından çok iyi hem de oldukça rahat bir konaklamaydı. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim. Özel bir günde buradaydık. Bizim için her şeyi daha da güzel kıldı diyebilirim. İlkay beye de ayrıca nezaketi için çok teşekkür ederim ☺️

We had a wonderful stay and couldn’t be happier with our experience. The room was very comfortable, beautifully maintained, and had an absolutely stunning view.
A special thank you to Akin and the entire team for their outstanding hospitality. From the moment we arrived, they were incredibly friendly, responsive, and helpful. They assisted us with transfers, answered all of our questions, and made sure everything went smoothly throughout our stay.
The communication was excellent, and we always felt welcomed and well taken care of. We would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Thank you again for such a great experience — we would love to come back in the future!

description: An artistic top-floor sanctuary in Cihangir—home to Istanbul’s creatives—this 2BR loft offers a rare 270° panoramic view from a massive wraparound balcony. The 70m² glass-walled living room floats above history: see Asia, Topkapı Palace, the Bosphorus, and the Golden Horn in one sweeping glance. Hand-crafted wood, sculpted zones, and sunlight from all sides make it perfect for romance, art, or absolute awe. You won’t want to leave—guaranteed.

reviews.text:
Noura's place was great, to say the least...
First, Noura is a magnificent host. She is very friendly, welcoming, and will be very available for whatever you might need. Communication with her was great. When we arrived, which was a bit late due to our flight being delayed, there was a problem with the hot water in the apartment. Noura stepped in and managed to get it fixed in no time.
Second, the apartment has one hell of a view. You can stay all day in the apartment just glancing through the window and imagining everything that has happened on the Bosphorus in the last 2 millenniums. The apartment is spacious, clean, very bright, it has an elevator, and it is located in a nice area with a supermarket around the corner. It is on a hill though, so bear in mind that if you don't go by car, the walks and staircases can be a bit steep.
If you decide to stay here, you will have a wonderful time. I hope I can be back soon. Thanks Noura and Shadi. Your hospitality was top notch!

Our stay at this apartment was very disappointing. Communication and support from the hosts were poor, they did not answer calls or messages when we arrived at airport with no internet, late due to flight delays, leaving us stranded. The apartment was not properly cleaned: used stained bedsheets, dirty dusty surfaces, kitchen and unwashed dusty blankets.
Safety was also a concern, there was no first aid kit when my sister burned her hands using coffee machine and the hosts offered no guidance. A curtain became stuck, compromising our view & rather than helping, the hosts immediately accused us of breaking it and threatened a $200 charge. The lift was not working for last three days, and we received conflicting, accusatory messages about it.
Despite all this, we remained polite, cooperative, and left the apartment cleaner than we found it. Unfortunately, the hosts’ unprofessionalism, poor communication, and unsafe, unclean conditions made this stay very stressful.

The view is absolutly amazing and the location is pretty good.
Nevertheless, the flat is under equipped… (Chair around the dining table, nearly nothing in the kitchen…)…
…and has some issue because it is old (windows that doesn’t close well, shower with little balloon or hot water, A/C that doesn’t work well)
Overall, a good experience but we were expecting a better prestation for such a nice flat (and for the price)
Also : Noora have a very good communication and let us leave our luggage during the afternoon of the last day. (Thx you)

A perfect stay! The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos, a sixth-floor unit with an elevator, offering breathtaking views. It's strategically located near the city center, just 30 minutes from Hagia Sophia and 5 minutes from the tram and buses. Access to the apartment is very easy; everything is automated, and contacting the owners is straightforward and they are incredibly helpful. 1000000% recommended! As they say, you won't want to leave. Thank you so much!

Exceptional sea view of the Bosphorus with daily ferry traffic visible from the living and master bedroom. The house is warm in cold weather, with enough towels provided. A mini market and several coffee shops are within walking distance, ideal for night owls. Kabataş metro and ferry stations are a 7-minute taxi ride away, and a taxi stand is just 2 minutes on foot.
However, the property has some drawbacks. It's not within walking distance of public transport, and there's no on-site parking; you'll need to park at the end of the street (4 minutes away) for $7–8 per night. The apartment requires full renovation, including unreliable hot water when multiple showers are needed. The old wooden lift is especially problematic—it rarely works down to the ground floor, requiring multiple attempts or using the stairs. The nightly rate feels high for a house in this condition, and even the kitchenware not enough for cooking once.

description: The apartment, which is close to commercial and shopping centers (Trump Towers and Cevahir Mall), banks, cinemas, theaters and art centers, has a special location in the city. You can easily reach E5, one of the main transportation routes in Istanbul, the metro, and the metrobus. There is a washing machine, kitchen, microwave, oven, air conditioning, cable TV and refrigerator in our place. Among the facilities offered are free Wi-Fi and free parking.

it was lovely staying there , the location is perfect , all who worked in the hotel were very friendly and helpful specially kenan , just the cleaning u have to ask for it every day .. everything was excellent 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Very nice residence and clean apartment. Everything was as described. Staff in reception were very courteous and friendly. Very convenient parking right by the entrance. Washer within unit was very convenient. I would definitely recommend it 👍

I stayed for several days , the cleaning is very good at apartment also host offers transfering from airport to place to make easier to get to place.
