reviews.text:
Stunning apartment and well located however catastrophic experience.
1- There was construction going on in the apartment with drilling and hammering noises all day. I had told the host that I was coming to work and rest. My host informed me that the construction had just started and that he would not have been able to warn me (but when I arrived it was visible that the construction had started days ago). I sense a lack of honesty here.
2- Water cut (a day from 10 PM to 12 AM). My host informs me that there is nothing he can do. I had to look on the internet myself to find out when the water would return. I still feel a lack of transparency on the part of the host.
My general impression of the hosts is not positive. They seemed to me to think more about their benefits than the well being of their guests.
Final remark: I did not appreciate the (unsympathetic) temperament of the hosts when I made my remarks. When I called the host to discuss, he spent 5 minutes telling me that he was in a hurry and had to leave. And when I left and asked for help to take my suitcase down (because there was no elevator) they refused. I had to find myself a person in the street to help me.
By experience, I know that there are more friendly hosts in Istanbul, so go to them rather than here.

Very nice and big apartment in the good neighborhood. We stayed here for a week in March, and enjoyed the stay. Apartment is exactly as it’s on the photos. Spacious and comfy.
Kitchen is equipped, everything was clean when we arrived.
Gohan met us when we arrived, responded quickly to all the questions, helped us to arrange a taxi to the airport.
Area is also very nice . Walking distance to the park, and Dolmanbahche place. There are a lot of fancy restaurants and interesting cafes around.

Amazing apartment and best location. The house is exactly like the photos and super clean. Gokhan was really helpful and very responsive. We really enjoyed our stay and definitely will not be our last time :)

The place is very clean, spacious and comfortable. The location is in the centre of Nisantasi, Osmanbey which are shopping centres in Istanbul. The hosts are lovely people. We really enjoyed our stay in Zeynep and Gokhan's place.

Dairenin konumu çok güzel, caddeye yakın, her yere ulaşım kolaydı. Araba park yeri için çevreyi bilmiyorsanız genellikle belediye haricinde ( genellikle yer bulunmuyor), özel otoparklar var ve fiyatlar çok fazlaydı. Daire daha temiz olabilirdi. Özellikle banyo ve tuvalet hijyen olarak iyi değildi .

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Serdar was the perfect host! Always helpful and responsible. He gave us lots of tips and helped with the parking.
The apartment is small and looks like the pictures, but it was far from clean. Maybe it comes from the fact that all the furniture is old. Good thing was that at least the beds were comfortable and clean, which was the important thing for us, because we spent only the nights in Valeriya’s place.
Overall Valeriya and Serdar are great hosts, their place is near to Istiklal street and Taksim square. I would come back but next time I’d prefer to sty at any of their other apartments.

The airbnb was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The space was well-maintained. Serdar was very helpful and quick to respond to any questions, making the whole experience smooth.
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay with such good price for the location!

Communication with our host was very easy and good. We stayed 4 adults in the apartment. The location is good, very close to a bus stop and walking distance from Taxim area with nice restaurants and shopping. There were also nice local places around to eat. The bathroom and kitchen needs maintenance, which cannot be seen in the photos. Nevertheless, we had a good stay.

We stayed 4 nights in this apartment as a group of 4 people, and we really enjoyed the experience. The biggest advantage is definitely the location: you’re very close to the Galata Tower and the whole nice area around it. Even though the street where the building is located isn’t very visually appealing, the apartment itself is lovely, clean, and well arranged. The only downside is that it’s a bit small for 4 people, but we managed just fine. Also, the bathroom and kitchen are a bit old and could use some renovation. On the other hand, the owner and his wife are very kind people, and we got along great with them. They were very helpful and let us leave our luggage at the accommodation after check-out (which was at 11 a.m.) until the evening, when we had our flight. We definitely recommend this place for its excellent location and the friendliness of the hosts!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Serdar's beautiful BnB! From the moment we arrived, Serdar was the perfect host—warm, welcoming, and attentive to every detail. The property itself is stunning, with a perfect blend of comfort and charm, making it feel like a true home away from home.
The rooms were impeccably clean, tastefully decorated, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we could possibly need. The surrounding area was serene, providing a perfect escape while still being conveniently located to explore.
Serdar went above and beyond to make our stay memorable, offering excellent recommendations and ensuring we were comfortable throughout. It’s clear he takes great pride in hosting, and it truly shows in every aspect of the experience.
We can’t recommend this BnB highly enough and are already looking forward to our next visit. Thank you, Serdar, for a stay that was nothing short of perfect!

description:
Our family-friendly comfortable apartments in Sisli, Istanbul, meet all the needs to make you feel at home. Our staff on duty is at your service from 10:00 to 22:00. There is 24 hour active security system and cameras for your safety. A comfortable accommodation experience awaits you with the comfort of an elevator in our apartments, which offer city views or the peace of calm streets.

*Note: If the dates you are looking for are not available, please message us :)

reviews.text:
The location of the department is great. Various shops such as a Carrefour branch is so close to the place. Osmanbey Metro and Bomonti bus stations are accessible with less than 10 minutes walk. So, it is highly suggested to someone who wants to access city center and visit Istanbul by using train and bus.
Alper is so kind and perfect in communication. We could call or send a text massage to him anytime and receive a response soon. Moreover, he was on time for both check in and check out. He helped us to settle in the location and he is a brilliant host.
The only problem was drainage because there was a bad smell in the toilet and nearby and the kitchen sink did not work properly because of drainage problem.

it is a good value, good communication, check in was easy and I appreciate that they accepted my same day booking. Place is very clean, and about 5 minutes walk from shopping and restaurants. There is a happy center supermarket one minute away from the place which is very nice. Two things would make the stay better : 1- the wifi was acting on and off during my stay which was not convenient 2- the apartment is under the ground level which was not known to me prior to booking.
I recommend this place.

I had an amazing stay! The place was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very kind, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to checkout. The neighborhood felt safe and had everything I needed nearby. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

I had a wonderful stay at Alper’s place! He was incredibly friendly and welcoming and went out of his way to make sure I felt comfortable. He was also very flexible with check-in and check-out times, which made my trip much easier. The accommodation was clean, cozy, and just as described. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. Thanks again, Alper!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb for my conference in the Sisli area. The location was convenient, making it easy to get to my conference venue. The apartment was simple but neat, clean, and equipped with all the facilities I needed to be comfortable during my stay. The host was also very responsive and ensured everything went smoothly. Highly recommend for anyone attending events nearby!

description:
Lovely flat in Bebek, in a peaceful and quiet building. It is 250 mt. away from Bebek center (where Chilai and Nusret is), and it's just across Petra Coffee.

*1 bedroom with a kingsize bed and wardrobe
*1 living room with a sofa that can also be a bed.
*Kitchen, bathroom
*Flat has been renewed in Jan'22
*Small garden at the back side, (exit from bedroom)
* A/C in the bedroom.
* Dehumidifier machine in the living room which makes the flat cooler especially during hot summer.
*~70 m2 internal

reviews.text: Lovely, cozy apartment in a great location. we enjoyed our stay at Aydin's place a lot. The apartment is only a couple of minutes walk to the center of Bebek, to the water front, and to the ferry station but it is on a quiet, green and residential street. Bebek itself is a beautiful neighborhood to enjoy a long walk along Bosphorus or try great coffee shops or restaurants but the ferry station there also makes it very convenient to go around the city and visit more touristy areas. Aydin and his co-host Aynur were very responsive and we had everything we needed in the apartment for a comfortable stay. We would love to stay there again on our next trip to Istanbul

I had a wonderful week-long stay at Aydin's home. The location was perfect as well - right across a trendy yet quaint coffee shop.
The space was large and had all the amenities we needed. We were beyond comfortable at the apartment.
I cannot wait to return and stay at this home again and/ or recommend it to my family and friends in the future.
The host was friendly, communicative, clear instructions, seamless check-in and check-out process.
The air conditioning was great and kitchen had all the amenities needed. Grocery stores and restaurants were close by as well making this the perfect location.

Before booking, I had some doubts about the flat due to the absence of reviews, but I took a chance, and I'm thrilled that I did. The host welcomed us warmly, providing a thorough introduction to the essentials. The apartment was impeccably clean and well-organized, creating a homey atmosphere. It was equipped with everything we needed – a cozy living space, fresh and crisp bed linens, a fully stocked kitchen, a 55inch smart TV, and reliable Wi-Fi, including a range extender in the back room and garden.
The host went above and beyond to ensure we felt at home. The neighbourhood was delightful, with the delightful wake-up call of birdsong. While I had previously experienced Bebek in the summer, discovering its winter charm was an unexpected delight.
To sum it up, what began as initial doubts transformed into a fantastic experience. Anyone considering a stay here is sure to appreciate the welcoming atmosphere and all the amenities provided.
Thanks Aydin....

I stayed at Aydin’s apartment for three weeks during a business trip, and I must say, I left feeling very happy about the choice I made. Aydin’s role as a host was exemplary. Even though he wasn't physically in town, he provided outstanding support. He virtually assisted with navigating the city, explaining the best ways to reach various areas, and was always available to answer any questions. His efforts in ensuring I had everything I needed, including helping me get a transport card and additional bedding, were greatly appreciated. The apartment itself was very cozy. Fully furnished, it had everything one might need for a pleasant stay. The addition of complimentary snacks, tea, and coffee was a very nice touch, making the place feel even more homely. As for the location, it’s in arguably the best neighborhood in Istanbul. Upscale and picturesque, it offers stunning views of the Bosphorus. My stay at Aydin's apartment was nothing short of fantastic. Highly recommend!

evi teslim aldığımızda tertemiz ve fotoğraflardaki gibiydi sahibi aydın bey
herkonuda bizimle ilgilendi konumu üst düzey, sahile 5 dk çok teşekkür ederiz.

description:
Bu rahat konaklama yerinde harika zaman geçireceksiniz.Occupying a unique location, the house is 10 meters from the Galata Tower and a 5-minute walk from the Metro Tram and bus stops. The apartment has a well-appointed bedroom and bathroom, all equipped with modern fixtures and amenities. The large roof terrace is shared with another unit.
Please note that there is no elevator in the building as this is a protected historic property.

reviews.text:
Ideal location with a quiet shared terrace that has a magnificent view of Istanbul and of Galata tower. You can easily walk across Galata bridge or along the river towards Dolmabahçe Palace. Vibrant neighborhood with proximity to "trendy" areas which are less visited by tourists. Food tends to be a little pricier in the area because of the proximity to Galata tower, but you can easily find "regular" prices by shopping/dining a bit further away.
Beautifully renovated studio, very clean with all of the amenities necessary.
Be prepared to climb stairs in the building and walk up steep hills in Galata.
Our host, Neriman was very friendly and easy to communicate with.
We will definitely want to stay here again when we come back!

First of all Neriman was extremely patient as I had sent her the wrong time for my arrival. After I fixed the miscommunication she was waiting for me once I arrived and took me to an extremely clean and modern apartment on the 5th floor of a tall Galata apartment building. Everything worked well - good Wi-Fi, comfy bed, great bathroom and living room area.
Best of all is the location and the jaw-dropping view on the shared rooftop where you can watch the sunset with a bottle of wine and see istanbul’s lights glow around the city. The call to prayers are an extra-added bonus.
Thanks for the beautiful stay!

The apartment is fantastic; perfect location in one of the coolest neighborhoods, comfortable bed, great shower, lovely view, and of course the rooftop terrace. Highly recommended.
Neriman is the ideal host. She is super helpful and kind. Next time I'm in Istanbul, I'm going to book this place.

Neriman was fantastic at communication with me in a clear and quick manner. She was very flexible with our check-in schedule.
The place was perfect! We spent the mornings and evenings on the rooftop terrace amazed at the city and history around us.
The location is perfect, tucked away right off the main touristy spots in an area that feels more local. It is nextdoor to good restaurants and around the corner from a grocery store.
Neriman was very clear that the place required walking up 4 flights of stairs and it was totally worth the effort! It is located in a historical building.
Neriman was very friendly, welcoming and helpful. I would definitely stay here again if I return. I highly recommend staying here to others!

We absolutely loved our stay here! The location is fantastic, the apartment was clean and airy and very comfortable. The rooftop terrace was incredible - we loved having morning Turkish coffee up there and watching the sunset with views of the old town including the most prominent historical landmarks. It was so nice to have coffee and tea provided on the terrace as well. Neriman was an incredibly responsive host. We would definitely stay here again!

description:
The views from the bedroom and roof terrace are absolutely amazing.
World class!
Even! The view from the roof at sunset is incredible!
Excellent location!
The apartment is confortable, well equipped, free wifi, light and airy. The neighborhood is great , safe, quiet, within easy walking distance to everything; shops, hammam, antique shops, supermarkets, some great restaurant, cute local cafes, breakfast places and the tram which quickly and easly takes you everywhere.

reviews.text:
If you are looking at this apartment, look no further and book it now. The pictures do not do the view justice. It is truly incredible and the best part of my stay in Istanbul. The location is in a great neighborhood. Safe, quiet, but surrounded by restaurants and an easy walk to a tram station that goes to the historic district. Osman will also suggest an amazing breakfast place two blocks away, definitely go there, the perfect Turkish breakfast for an incredible value.

Osman is also great. Stayed up late to get me into the apartment, gave me a nice orientation to the city. He was available as needed for any questions I had.

The apartment itself was nice and clean. There is one bedroom with a comfortable queen bed, and the same incredible view as the rooftop. An amazing place to wake up and go to sleep. The kitchen is good if you want to cook. The is a washing machine with a drier feature, and a clothes line out the window. And the living room as a TV, a small couch, and a one person couch/bed. There is also an inflatable mattress you can put on the floor. And a French press for coffee.

WiFi is very strong, great speed.

Only negative was that there isn't a ton of hot water, but enough for a quick showe

Лучшие Апартаменты в моей жизни с великолепным видом 💔😭
ENGLISH BELOW
Во - первых, вид на город и сами Апартаменты намного лучше, чем на фото! Это правда! Не хотелось уезжать…
Плюсы:
+ Просторные Апартаменты
+ Великолепный вид отовсюду. Сплошное наслаждение. Мы даже не ходили в рестораны, питались в апартаментах, чтобы наслаждаться прекрасным видом на город
+ Стильный дизайн! Уделено внимание мелочам
+ В апартаментах есть абсолютно все для комфортного проживания: кухонные принадлежности, фен, холодильник, маски, стиральная машина, шампунь и т.д.
+ Прекрасное расположение. Все знаковые места очень близко
+ Рядом много магазинов(в том числе и Carrefour), кафе и банкоматов
+ Недалеко находится смотровая площадка
Минусов нет!
Осман прекрасный хозяин! Встретил тепло и дружелюбно. Было очень приятно познакомиться. Помог донести чемодан по винтовой лестнице. Всегда был на связи.
А ещё здесь есть прекрасная терраса на крыше.
Рекомендую! И с радостью вернулась бы снова!
_________
Best Apartment in my life with great views 💔😭
Firstly, the view of the city and the Apartment itself is much better than in the photo! This is true! I didn't want to leave ...
Pluses:
+ Spacious Apartments
+ Great views from everywhere. Sheer pleasure. We didn’t even go to restaurants, we ate in the apartments to enjoy the beautiful view of the city
+ Stylish design! Attention is paid to the little things
+ The apartment has absolutely everything for a comfortable stay: kitchen utensils, hairdryer, refrigerator, masks, washing machine, shampoo, etc.
+ Great location. All iconic places are very close
+ Nearby many shops (including Carrefour), cafes and etc.
+ There is an observation deck nearby
There are no downsides!
Osman is a wonderful host! Was greeted warmly and friendly. It was very nice to meet you. Helped carry the suitcase up the spiral staircase. I was always in touch.
It also has a lovely rooftop terrace.
Recommend! And I would love to come back again!

Great flat and great host! Makes my holiday in Istanbul so relaxing and wonderful. The flat is exactly the same with the pictures show, cozy, stylish, clean, well equipped. The view from bedroom and the shared roof just upstairs, is so fantastic! You can see the beautiful golden corn seaview, the Galata tower, Ayasophia, Topkapi palace, Blue mosques. The view of sunset and evenings is specially amazing. Location of the flat is just perfect for me, very convenient to visit sight seeing by tram or by ferry, while with a proper distance to the crowded
tourist area, the neighborhood is charming with cafés, little shops, and it is safe and quiet.
And the host, Osman, is so hospitality and offers help to everything I need! Picked me up at Taksim, helped to carry my luggage to 5th floor, very detailed introduction of the neighborhood, great recommendation for breakfast, let me late checkout cos my flight is at night. And finally even give me a lovely gift, which is so sweet! So, Osman, a big thanks! I really appreciated for everything, and will definitely recommend your flat.

Amazing view of the city - worth the climb up the stairs. Osman is a great host, he met us and helped with our luggage for both check in and out even though we had to leave very early in the morning for our flight. There are a lot of stairs but if you are physically fit it's totally doable. The apartment was comfortable and clean and amazing value with kitchen, paid washer, living room and rooftop access. Would stay here again if we come back!

GREAT HOST AND SPECTACULAR VIEWS OF ISTANBUL. Nice apartment on the 4th floor but no lift / elevator so you need to be able to climb steps, about 70 in total from the street. The climb is worth the effort as the panoramic view from the kitchen and bedroom is spectacular. Osman is a fantastic host. He offered to arrange the private transfers to and from the airport, which we are so pleased we accepted, and Osman was there to great us when we arrived and help with our bags and the same when we left. He also gave us an excellent intro to the apartment and a briefing on how to use the transport system in the city and the sights to see. The apartment is very close to the major tourist attractions which you get to quickly using the tram line and there is a station about 10 minutes walk from the apartment. There are also many shops and restaurants nearby. Highly recommended.

description: Modern flat in the heart of Moda, Kadıköy, with quick access to metro, ferry, and public transport. Fine dining, shops, and entertainment are within walking distance. Located on the first floor with high ceilings, offering a spacious feel. Fully equipped with high-speed internet (1000 Mbps), dishwasher, washing machine, fridge, Smart TV, vacuum, iron, coffee machine, and kitchen essentials to make you feel at home.

reviews.text:
Berk was really responsive, and the flat was actually even better than on the photos. It was warm inside, and clean, the kitchen was well equipped, the television had streaming services installed.
Of course the location is good as well, Kadiköy is a buzzing but at the same time calm place, 10-15 minutes from metro, ship which can take you anywhere inside the city.
I would totally recommend to anyone.

We had a wonderful stay in Kadıköy. The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for our trip. We especially loved the location — it was perfect for exploring Kadıköy, with plenty of cafés, restaurants, shops, and public transport nearby.
The area felt lively but still very easy to get around, and it was great to experience the local side of Istanbul. The check-in process was smooth, communication was easy, and everything in the apartment was well organised.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would happily stay here again. Definitely recommended for anyone looking for a clean, comfortable place in a great location in Kadıköy.

We had a very nice 2 weeks stay at Berk's apartment during Christmas and New Year vacation with my partner and our family.
The apartment was the same as shown on the photos and comfortable for 5 people.
The area is quite and even apartment being located on the first floor we're not bothered by noise from the street (only during New Year's night but that was expected:))
Apartment is located just few minutes walking from a very nice park near the sea.
Berk is very attentive and always ready to help with our questions and request we had during the stay. Check-in and check-out were super easy. Berk even helped us to organize a transfer from airport to his place which was very nice of him.
Very good Wi-fi in case you need to work there and we also enjoyed a very cozy coffee place Guten Morgen located in the same building.
We can recommend Berk's place for your stay in Istanbul.
Thank you, Berk!

The check-in was easy and smooth. Check out even better.
Nice location, close to restaurants, bars, pharmacies, and public transport.
Maybe not suitable for people with light sleep because of the street (passing cars, people, tram) and upstairs neighbors noise (there is no sound isolation between floors, and the people upstairs were not mindful at all!).
If you plan to cook, or do laundry, the apartment is fully equipped. Just remember to bring dish washer and/or washing machine soap, alongside with small conveniences: salt, sugar, kitchen paper...
It fits easy 6 people.

Berk was genuinely a great host - proactive, earnest in his accessibility and very responsive to guests, and action-oriented. The location itself is prime, highly walkable, near wonderful cafes and restaurants. The apartment is as described, and a toddler bed and high chair were available. My family and I were initially a bit disappointed with the underlying cleanliness, but Berk was immediate in addressing our concerns.

description:
Welcome to Grisverde Suites in vibrant Ataşehir, Istanbul.
Our modern suites are ideal for business travelers, medical visitors, and tourists.

Enjoy a separate living and bedroom, a comfortable sofa bed, and a luxurious bathroom with a walk-in shower and hairdryer.

The stylish workspace and fast Wi-Fi keep you connected. Experience the comfort of home with hotel luxury. Book your stay at Grisverde Suites today!

reviews.text:
The apartment is fine and clean, the owner is friendly and speaks English really well
I noticed only a few disadvantages in the kitchen: in the description it was written that there was no kitchen, but it was in the photos, and this confused me. In the photos, the kitchen is poorly visible, and it turned out to be quite uncomfortable:
- the sink is located in the corner of the kitchen, and it’s difficult to access;
- the electric kettle didn’t work, but then the owner replaced it
- dishes and cutlery are not very good, and there are no dishes for cooking at all, whereas there is a stove
- the kitchen as a whole is not very logically arranged, there are no rags or detergent, but there is a dishwasher
In general, if it’s important for you to have a normal comfortable kitchen, keep this in mind, but otherwise everything was nice

I had an incredible stay at Gris Verde Suites. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the stylish, modern decor and the attention to detail in every corner of the suite. The space was very clean, with a comfortable bed, kitchen, and a cozy living area that made it easy to relax after a day of exploring.
It's situated in a quiet, safe neighborhood in Ataşehir but still close to great restaurants, cafes, and shops. The hosts were incredibly welcoming and responsive, offering local tips and making sure I had everything I needed throughout my stay.
Highly recommend Gris Verde Suites for anyone visiting the area.

I recently stayed at Gris Verde Suites and was impressed by the spacious, well-equipped apartment. The suite offers everything you need for a comfortable stay, including a living room, a fully equipped kitchen, a bedroom, and a spacious bathroom. The convenience of having a private parking space is a big plus, especially if you're exploring Istanbul by car.
Located in the vibrant Ataşehir district of Istanbul, it's surrounded by lively cafes, student hangouts, and famous fast food chains, all within short walking distance. The neighborhood features great energy, making it a fantastic place to explore and relax. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a balance between comfort and the vibrant city life without breaking your budget.
A new comfortable apartment without the smell of cigarettes, which is very important to me. Shops, cafes, as well as local markets on Mondays and Thursdays are within walking distance.

I stayed for 3 nights and it was great. You will feel like home. Peaceful and quiet area. Helpful host. Clean place. And everything was nice. I Highly recommend it if you are looking for a quiet place, great service, clean space and good price.

description: We look forward to hosting you in our cozy flat thats literally steps away from the Glorious Istanbul Bosphorus.

reviews.text:
I stayed at the apartment for 14 days and my experience was pretty positive. It felt like home!
The apartment was neat, clean and cozy. Photos are 100% accurate.
Baris and Yildiz were responsive to my messages and I had no trouble communicating with them. I even asked for some tools to be used in the kitchen and got them provided by Abla Khadija in minutes :)
The neighborhood is peaceful Located in beautiful Kuzguncuk (Asian side) and only meters away from public transportation and several restaurants/cafes.
Address was easy to find for delivery orders.
The apartment is on the ground floor which is a plus because you don’t have to climb the stairs with your bags but you should be attentive when the windows are open as cats won’t miss a chance to climb around and get inside even with the installed fence :)) But they’re so beautiful and friendly so don’t worry about it.
You won’t regret booking this place!
Thank you for the beautiful experience✨

I was happy with my Kuzguncuk experience on the Asian side of Istanbul. Kuzguncuk is a quaint and quiet village with lots of restaurants, cafés, and groceries.
Regarding the apartment it is located at the street level of an old building and everything is exactly as on the photos. It is close to the Bosphorus shore, to the transportation means and 15' minutes walk from Üsküdar (a hub for ferries, buses, metro and MarmaRay to reach the European side of Istanbul).
The neighbourhood is quite secure, I never felt unsecured late at night as a solo female traveller while coming back to the apartment.
Baris was a good host, very responsive and helpful.
Apartment drawbacks:
- during my stay the weather was terribly hot and unfortunately there's no AC in the bedroom but hopefully one AC unit exists in the living room where I ended up sleeping every night on the sofa;
- a bad smell of sewage was coming from the bathroom and the kitchen's sink that was putting-off;
- a dog in the courtyard next to

We booked 6 nights at Baris’ place for the marathon. Although we have stayed in a couple of other towns in Istanbul we didn’t know lots about üsküdar as an area but we absolutely loved it! The apartment is a fantastic location. 2 mins walk away to a road full of coffee shops, bakery and restaurants. Very local feel but lots to see and do. Beautiful views of the Bosphorous close by and coastal strolls. Public transport great. The flat itself is cosy and comfortable for my sister and I and as described. Baris and his aunt were super helpful and very hospitable! Would return again. Thanks!

This place was very conveniently located in the lovely trendy neighbourhood of Kuzguncuk, with lots of great cafes, shops, a couple of bookshops and galleries. There are plenty of buses that go the couple of ks down to Uskadar for ferries or it's a 15 min or so walk. Inside it's comfortable and clean, couples might find the bedroom a little cramped. I never actually met Baris but my enquiries were answered very quickly. His aunt lives in the building and greeted me, she was very friendly, but doesn't speak a word of English and I don't speak Turkish. It was a great place to be based, it felt local and is away from the touristsy European side. I would have appreciated an English speaking host on site to help with local knowledge.

Kuzguncuk is a beautiful neighborhood. Bariş's place was about one block to the main street, lined with trees and sidewalk cafes. Two blocks to the bus stop. But just enough away to be a in quiet neighborhood (other than the mosque calls to prayer).
The apartment is filled with every convenience Bariş could think of, most notably an amazing washer and a dryer. The apartment is a bit tight in areas, for instance the window side of the bed. But which amenities would you want to give up to make more space?
Another thing we appreciated was the divided bathroom. Looking in from the hall, the sink area is straight ahead, and the shower and toilet are in separate rooms to the left and right.
Bariş was very responsive at all times. The day of our check-in, he had a family emergency, but made sure a neighbor was available to let us in.

description: This bright flat at the heart of Istanbul offers serenity in the midst of a central location, thanks to its rare and leafy backyard. Recently refurbished, it has convenient transport links and a developing community with little shops, cafes and an organic food market.

reviews.text: Osman's cosy flat is a little haven from Istanbul's busy and vibrant streets. It has a leafy nice garden at the back, a luxury among the high rise buildings and crazy traffic. The flat is newly furbished, it is plain but has everything you need. Comfy bed, comfy couch, working wifi, clean sheets oh and Osman's awards for you to admire.He is actually a very famous Turkish photographer, who took the iconic picture of "lady in red" during the park protests two years ago. (Im a journalist myself so was bit like staying at a celebrity's house for me). He was responsive, helpful and friendly during my stay and greeted me upon my checking in. Would have been excellent if there was A/C as Istanbul was boiling, but fan in the ceiling was mostly enough. The flat is located in a relatively quiet street, there's taxi corner 50 meters away. There are shops, markets on the main street. It is around 10 minute walking distance to Osmanbey metro, which is one stop to Taksim. So overall, this place is great value for money and I'd comfortably recommend it to others.

Apartment:
Listing is fairly accurate. The apartment is spacious and well furnished, although it is on the -1 floor and you can smell the mould. Bedroom is quiet if you keep the window shut, otherwise it opens to a busy and dusty street. Kitchen is well equipped and opens to a little garden with table and chairs for two, which during my stay weren't very tidy (apartment itself was clean though).

For people with allergies:
In the garden there were a family of cats - mother and 5 kittens, which were very cute, but dusty and full of lice. Also keeping them out of the apartment is impossible, as they would be in, the moment you open the kitchen door to the garden, which you want to do if weather is good. Once in, cats do like to mess around and caused some troubles for me during my stay.

Neighbourhood:
Neighbourhood is fantastic. One of the most authentic experiences in Istanbul that you can get! A lot of choice of locally grown fruits and vegetables, home made food and desserts. Osmanbey metro station is less than 10 minutes away from the apartment. Streets are lively until late.

Host:
Host attitude varies from very nice to rude when issues were reported.

The place is occupied by the owner. it's dirty, smelly, MUSTY and dark. it's a basement apartment with the owner's stuff in it. It was a rushed reservation that was very regrettable. I assumed staying in a 2 bedroom apartment would be big enough for 3 people but wasn't. the second bedroom was very dark and has a tiny bed that didn't fit my daughter and had a back ache the next morning. We had to put the mattress on the floor and a blanket at her feet to be able to sleep. the sheets were the owner's and were dirty and smelly. the owner smokes and the apartment reeks. Same as the fridge which the owner left his stuff in. This was the worst and dirtiest place I ever stayed in. the pictures are deceiving on the site. There were holes in the kitchen that were filled with plastic. This is was a rushed decision and for the price there are many other nice places in the city. The next time, I'd request a virtual tour.

Osman is very friendly and hospitable host. The apartment is clean, has everything you need for a comfortable life during the trip. Nice garden. We are adults and our three children loved the apartment. Near the residence there are several paid parking. Problems with parking the car will not. Not very far from the Osman's apartment supermarket Migros. Who cares, very near a taxi rank. We can recommend to others.

What a nice choice for stay on Istanbul , osman and his girlfriend made them self available for any advices we need, clean and bright and comfortable house, better than hotels for sure and much cheaper, don't think about it just book it because it's even better and bigger than the pictures, thank you for having us, we will come back for sure

description:
Available for over 100-day stays.

Located in the heart of Cihangir, this bright and modern apartment features two bedrooms, a spacious living room, and a private rooftop terrace with stunning Bosphorus views. You can walk to Taksim in just a few minutes while enjoying the calm, artistic atmosphere of the neighborhood.

Ideal for both business and leisure stays — warm, inviting, and comfortable.

reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay. Enis was really helpful and responsive, also Sevda welcomed us very warm and friendly. Location wise I have to say it was amazing, beautiful cafes and restaurants nearby alao close to many attractions such as Galata tower and Galata Port. The building was also very quiet and safe. The unit was the same as shown in the photos with magnificent view.
The only reason I gave 4 star is that the smell from the sink that was mentioned in the previous reviews was quite intense sometimes, also the shower head was not mounted well. when i mentioned this to Enis he offered and managed someone to check in though abd he followed up a few times.
Thanks!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this Airbnb, and it exceeded all my expectations. The location was superb, right in the heart of the city with easy access to shops, restaurants, and public transportation. The host's attention to detail was evident in every aspect of the accommodation.
The apartment was tastefully decorated, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The cleanliness was impeccable, and amenities provided made the stay incredibly comfortable. From a well-equipped kitchen to high-quality linens, every detail was carefully thought out.
What truly set this Airbnb apart was the host's hospitality. They were responsive and accommodating, providing helpful tips about the local area and ensuring that my stay was seamless. It felt like a home away from home, thanks to the warm and welcoming environment created by the host.
Overall, I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone seeking a convenient, comfortable, and enjoyable stay.

This has the potential to be an excellent listing. It‘s spacious for a small group, it has a large private terrace with amazing views across the Bosphorus, it’s easily walkable to Taksim Square, Galata Tower, Galataport, etc, and you feel right at the heart of things. However, what lets it down is its lack of maintenance and cleanliness. The photos are accurate, but can’t have been updated in ages. There were burns on the furniture, nails poking out, sockets hanging out, batteries and bulbs missing, and significant wear and tear throughout. The bathroom ceiling and walls were mouldy, the shower was hard to use, and the toilet flusher didn’t work. Various surfaces and walls were sticky and marked, the cups and cutlery were dirty, the aircon was thick with dust, and the clothes airer was rusty and unusable. The apartment just overall felt lacking in attention, and didn’t seem like it had been deep cleaned for a long time. If you’re willing to overlook these things, this is a great stay

This is a spacious and equipped apartment in a good location for exploring the center of Istanbul & the rest of the city. Careful: if you’re travelling with kids and a stroller, the area is very hilly and steep.
Pros:
- Harbor & tram that takes you to Sultanahmet & other spots is really close & convenient.
- The view from the terrace is beautiful, exactly what’s needed after a long day exploring the city.
- Lots of space in the apartment.
- Communication with Enis is a breeze. Quick replies, friendly attitude and very helpful.
Cons:
- The bathroom needs maintenance. The shower in particular should be replaced.
- The building is old, so there’s a distinct sewage smell coming from the kitchen. Ask the owner for smell sticks - Enis provided us with some, they helped fight off the smell.
- The walls need some love - there are noticeable black streaks & cracks in many spots.

The apartment is in a great location, close to cafes and shops and very close to Taksim metro and shopping street.The apartment has everything as in the photo: a very stylish design ( paintings are my love), a chic private terrace with a view of the Bosphorus, where you can spend the evening admiring the views, a kitchen with everything you need, air conditioners that will save you in the heat, good beds.
The host is very polite and pleasant , quickly gets in touch !
If I am in Istanbul with a company , I will definitely stay in these apartments again ! Thank you for your hospitality !

description: Our centrally located place is a 20-minute walk to the Taksim metro station and a 10-minute walk to Istiklal Avenue, where there are shops and restaurants.

reviews.text: Room was accurately described and the host was very kind and friendly. Location is close to city centres and there are plenty of stores and restaurants near by. Public transport and taxi are also available. The street itself is a bit conjugated with no parking available. Other than this, we enjoyed our stay. Thank you.
Very good location. Room is soo good and enough for 2 person.Also host is soo kind,heartfelt and very friendly. If I come back to Istanbul again I’ll stay here with no hesitation. Thank you ❤️
Very responsive host and pretty good apartment! All amenities are there.
Zeliha hanım gerçekten muhteşem bir ev sahibi ayrıca misafirleri için her türlü desteği sağlayan birisi. Kendisine teşekkür ediyorum.
Zeliha hanım çok ilgiliydi. Daire tertemizdi ve girişi kolaydı. Herkese tavsiye ederim

description: Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space.

Perfect for a family of three or four and suitable for short and long stays alike.

I’ve been travelling a lot through my work and I have stayed in many apartments before the host is one of the greatest people I have met. He is very kind, very responsive very helpful. I do recommend this place

High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room and One Fan in the bedroom.

reviews.text: It was a nice staying. The check-in instructions were very detailed and clear and the host was very helpful. The host was very helpful. The house was just like in the photos and very clean. It had everything necessary for a good staying. Beside the location, I highly recommend it.

I had a really great stay at this place! The apartment was clean, modern, and very comfortable. The location was not the nearest– but i could find everything I needed. The check-in process was smooth and the host was very friendly and helpful. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area, and I’d love to stay here again in the future!
We had a great stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place.

Apartment is worth its price, very clean, supermarket near, but the location is not popular, as it is far away from Istanbul center. It is a good working environment for workers from home.
If you want to see Istanbul, you will regularly need taxi, because of the long distance. Public transport is cumbersome and you can only take the mini bus, if any.

I had a safe and wonderful experience at this accommodation. Clean place and parking is a plus. Communication was excellent, every question and details i needed was answered in a matter of seconds. I definitely recommend this place.

description:
Our apartment is luxurious, modern and carefully designed. Located in our hotel, this apartment has a large double bed in the bedroom, a 43 -inch smart television in the living room, and a private bathroom. Our apartment has a fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator and kitchen utensils.
Our room is on the 1st floor. There is a 24/7 camera and security system. The exterior door of the building is specially coded and protected. Our apartment is designed to accommodate 2 people.

reviews.text:
The place is close to the Bosphores by walking 5-7 mins. You can go by bus to Bebek or to Beşiktaş fast. If you love more Taksim Direction I would not recommend you here. I personally wanted to live in a calm surroundings to know the people and culture. There are lots of restaurants in main street by 2 mins walking. Never will be hungry even at 22:00 pm. Drugstores also closed.
The place was so clean and as shown in the picture. If you get problem by warm water just call or write the host. They will help you. Truthful surroundings. Safe area. The flat needs more dishes and stuff if you like to cook.
I felt home. The host was friendly and very responsive also several times asked how everything is and came for help.
Thank you for your hospitality.

Bu evde ikinci kez konakladım, ev ile ilgili herşey yazıldığı gibiydi ve fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi. Konumu, temizliği, olanakları, fiyat/performans dengesi ve ev sahibinin iletişimi çok iyiydi. İstanbul seyahatimde yeniden konaklamak isterim.

The place is amazing, and near to a lot of interesting places, everything was clean, new, looks like photos.
Kubilay is friendly and very helpful, I faced an issue and he and the receptionist helped me late at night.
I already recommended this place to my friends, I would come here again.

It was a lovely and cosy apartment, located in a quiet street. You can see a lot of shops in the Main Street that is a few mins walk away. There are buses from nearby to access to the metro. Only cons were the steep and narrow stairs leading to the apartment and the size of the shower space. Otherwise, a great host and a tasteful apartment!

My stay at Kubilay’s place was great. Apartment is located in the very center of the town and you can find anything you want day and night. Lots of options for eating. Very clean, quite and comfortable.
The host, Kubilay, was very friendly and responsible. It was so easy to find him and he was very helpful.
I would highly recommend this place for others. On my next trip, I will plan and stay here again.
Thanks again Kubilay!
Guney from Australia

description: Enjoy your stay in one the most central and trendy neighborhood of the city; Cihangir.

reviews.text:
Fatih’s place was the perfect stay for 5 days in Istanbul! He was super responsive and communicative, meeting us for check in and check out. The place was clean and comfortable and stocked with water, coffee, and tea. Location was prime, was 7 min walk from the tram station (going back is straight uphill so a bit of a trek) and had a lot of great food spots within a 5-10 min walk.
The only con is not related to the place but Fatih helped call a taxi for our return flight and I thought they would be trustworthy but like all taxis they scammed us by adding 100 lira extra to our payment. Make sure to always check what they are putting in their card reader and take a picture of the taximeter for proof for a dispute if needed.

Cosy, clean and comfortable apartment with tasteful decorations. The kitchen has a lovely view of the Galata Tower. Very good location. Walking distance the supermarket, restaurants, cafes and the most popular neighborhood. 5-10 minutes walk to T1 and the Modern Art Museum. 20 minutes walk to Taksim. Fatih is very helpful and responsive. He came to meet us and helped to carry the luggages upstairs although it was 9PM. He showed us every equipment in the apartment like a magician. The apartment has everything we need even the SIM card eject pin tool. He also helped to communicate with the taxi driver when we leave. Wonderful B&B experience!

We spent 5 days, family of three, with grown-up daughter.
The apartment was spotlessly clean and like on the photos. The matrasses on the softer side. Perfect for three persons, also LCD TV, Netflix, working WIFI, well equpped kitchen, drinking water.
Fatih was really helpful and attentive. He helped to occupy the flat and explained the attractions, also provided a map, responded quickly always.
The sorrounding is not so shiny but it is OK, also close to the attractions. Nearby EsspressoLab is a gem if you like specialty coffee.

Fatih was an extremely helpful, generous and highly responsive host, helping us with extra linen and a taxi to the airport and ensuring that we were comfortable in his Airbnb. We really appreciated the supply of bottled water, soap for the dishwasher and washing machine and the thoughtful provision of the bus/tram card which we could top up as needed. The apartment is well-designed and was well-equipped and maintained with beautiful furniture and curtains. The bathroom is new and very compact with plenty of hot water. All linen was very clean and fresh and the bed is very comfortable. The location was ideal for us as it is in an interesting area close to supermarkets, shops, restaurants, chemists and bus/tram stops. It is just a short walk to Taxsim Square and a stroll down the hill to the Galata Bridge, and then by bus or tram to Sultanahmet. Galata Tower is also within walking distance. We stayed for a week and were very comfortable; would highly recommend this Airbnb.

This has to be the best AirBnB I have lived in so far!
The apartment is perfect, it has soul and coziness to it with antique-looking interior pieces, but at the same time it is very modern, clean and comfortable. All imaginable kitchen appliances are available. The bathroom is of great quality, shower has perfect water isolation and good drain (never leaks or clutters).
Cihangir is now my favorite Istanbul district, it has the best of both worlds: mostly quiet and comfortable, and at the same time all the cool restaurants, party places and other attractions of the city are within a short walking distance. You can also see Galata Tower from the windows of the apartment.
Finally, Fatih is a very polite host and was always very helpful, it felt great to be his guest, and I would love to stay again in my future visits to Istanbul.

description:
Explore Istanbul’s vibrant streets with this comfortable, self-contained apartment as your base.
The apartment is located in Sisli where you’ll find a great variety of restaurants, cafes, and shops at your doorstep.

New, bright and clean apartment decorated in natural tones with greenery to provide comfort and homey atmosphere during your stay.

The apartment is not missing out on modern appliances including Air Condition, WiFi, TV, dishwasher, automated coffee machine and much more.

reviews.text: In the photos, this apartment looks new and beautiful; the photos do not reflect the actual condition of the apartment. The apartment is long overdue for renovations. There are stains on the walls, the shower is broken, and the apartment looks run-down. None of the mirrors have enough lighting to apply makeup. Motorcycles and scooters are constantly driving down the streets, making it impossible to open the window. Maybe it’s fair for the price, but I expected something different based on the photos provided. If you’re looking for a cozy place to stay, this option won’t work for you. The only plus of this place is that communication with the host was clear, and we were able to get into the apartment easily.

The place was below average as apartment and neighborhood. There was no cleaning equipment or sponge even to wash the dishes! However, the sponge was provided later!! There was serious problem with car parking where I was clear that I can park my car free of charge if I find but I had someone who flattened the tires. It seems that I was not welcomed and I’ve been told to use far away paid parking which will cost $10 a night!! If you have a car don’t even think of book in any place near to this. There is no washing machine which makes it really difficult specially when you travel with kids. Condo and the team were responsive but I felt a communication gap since it seems that this is under more than one person to handle.

İstanbul’daki tatilimiz için seçtiğimiz bu daire gerçekten harikaydı! Konumu çok merkeziydi, aynı zamanda sessiz ve huzurluydu. Daire tertemiz, düzenli ve konforlu olup ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey düşünülmüştü. Ev sahibi son derece ilgili ve yardımseverdi, her sorumuza hızlıca yanıt verdi. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. İstanbul’a gelecek olanlara gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim!

I really enjoyed my stay here. The location was great and the place was very easy to find. The neighborhood was lovely, and there is a bus stop right at the beginning of the street, with routes to many of the places you may want to visit.
The apartment itself was beautiful, clean, and well-equipped, and having air conditioning was definitely a plus. Cordo, the host, was very responsible, kind, and respectful, and was always helpful when needed.
Overall, I had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed my trip.

description:
- In the heart of Istanbul, just 2 min. from the sea,
- All transportation systems (Metro, Metrobus, Marmaray, Ferry, etc.) that provide easy transportation to all parts of Istanbul
- To the intercity train station,
- Spacious 2+1 apartment on 2nd floor within walking distance to many major hospitals...
Our apartment, located on a quiet street in the historical district where there are many cafes, restaurants, bars, entertainment centers, concert/show halls, has been renovated to meet all your needs. There is a split air conditioner in the living room.

reviews.text:
Great location - close to anything that you might need in terms of transportation (the ferries, metro, buses). At the same time, a lot to do in this part of Istanbul, many decent bars/clubs/restaurants.
The place matched the photos exactly, no questions on cleanliness. The host provided clear instructions on how to get to and into the apartment. He also sent notes on good places to visit around and the sights we could visit.
All the amenities were also in place. Overall, perfect stay. And the price is reasonable in my opinion.

We really enjoyed Hakan's apartment. He was very responsive, and flexible with check-in (had to wait for us for more than an hour because of a taxi issues, and it was kind of him). The apartment itself is newly built, and it felt practically luxurious. The shower was the best of our 4 month trip so far...I didn't want to leave the shower :). The kitchen had the basics you need, and the beds were comfortable. Despite the beautiful apartment, the gem is the neighborhood. It is a block from a street full of lovely cafes to eat and work in, markets, bakeries, and only 5-6 blocks from the ferries. And yet still feels fairly peaceful and away from all that. It was a perfect mix of a residential/fun and alive neighborhood. It's not in the middle of the touristy places - you need a ferry for that - but it was exactly what we needed.

We had a wonderful stay at Hakan’s apartment in Kadıköy. The apartment was exactly as described—modern, spotless, stylish, and very comfortable. It was well-equipped with everything we needed, and the open kitchen and living area made it feel like a home away from home.
The location was excellent, with easy access to restaurants, cafés, shops, and public transportation, making it a perfect base for exploring Istanbul. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and Hakan was responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout our stay.
We truly enjoyed our time here and would happily stay again on our next visit to Istanbul. Highly recommended!

This place was wonderfully clean and very centrally located. It was easy to get to all transportation and into the heart of Kadiköy and the rest of Istanbul. Although with the price we paid, we were disappointed in some of the aspects of the place. The thin bed covers felt coarse like sleeping with towels and there was barely enough to cover both my husband and I, there wasn't any soap of any kind in shower, and the bed was stiff and uncomfortable. With the price I think we just expected more. Great for short stays especially if you need to be close to transportation to go sightseeing.
Great value place, in a fantastic part of Kadiköy, lots of good food, cafes and vintage stores in walking distance. Clean and comfortable - fabulous host!!

description:
Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby.

You’ll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text:
Wonderful Stay at this Residence
“I had an amazing stay at this Residence in Istanbul! The apartment was modern, clean, and very comfortable. The rooms were spacious, the furniture was stylish, and everything I needed was available. The residence itself is secure and well-maintained, with excellent facilities and a peaceful atmosphere.

Excellent experience and highly recommended!

We had a really nice experience staying at AkdInn. The apartment was clean, the view was great, and the location was excellent, with everything you could need right underneath and within easy reach.
A special thank you to Monther, who was very friendly, helpful, and responsive throughout our stay. We’d also like to thank Basel for his support. We really appreciated how welcoming and helpful they both were. The souvenir they kindly gave us at check-out was such a lovely and thoughtful touch.

Great location. Area was nice and clean. Just the AC was a bit of a problem because it wouldn’t get as cold the room but other than that it was good.

Everything was great from start to finish! The space was spotless, well-equipped, and very comfortable. Check-in was easy, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The location was perfect, and we truly enjoyed our time here. I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb and would love to come back in the future.

It was such a nice place, It has more services than 5 star hotel. Plus all the resorts acticvities like gym, pool, and sauna all are covered wth your room price. Hosts were very responsve and helpful. Totally recommend nothing is missing from what you have in your own house.

description: Beautiful apartment in the heart of Cihangir, available for 4+ month stays from June 1. Enjoy balcony and terrace views over historic Istanbul. Located on a lively street with antique shops, cafés, and a vibrant local feel. Central, walkable, and full of character. A perfect base to truly experience the city. I’m an easygoing host, and you’ll feel at home here.

reviews.text:
I stayed in Alev`s attic rooms for eleven days. It is a great place! The rooms have been perfectly quiet, clean, and nicely furnished. Although I stayed on my own it is easily a place to also accommodate a couple. It is a comfortable and cosy place to relax in this pulsating city. The bed is good (I slept perfectly well even without hearing the muezzin at five o`clock in the morning) and the washing basin served well. Alev offered me to have a shower in her bathroom downstairs at any time. You might have to get used to the sloped ceiling in the attic rooms and also to the fact that you have to use a ladder to reach them on the second level of her flat. But this is not a minus at all and should not influence yours decision to stay at her place.
The flat of Alev is perfectly located in the centre of Cihangir near Taksim square. From there all places of interest in Istanbul are easy to be reached by public transport. It is near Istiklal high street and you have nice places around to have dinner or a coffee.
Alev is a open-minded and entirely uncomplicated host. Her English is fluent. Every time, when we have met in her flat we had a good conversation about interesting things to do in the city, about Turkish politics, and the Turkish way of life. She recommended me some good places to hang out in Istanbul. She is a very friendly person and I never felt uncomfortable with her and her friends at any time. I highly recommend her as a host and would stay again with her when coming back to Istanbul. Thank you, Alev!

Alev was a great host - a welcoming, friendly and interesting person who took time to chat to us even when coming back from a long day at work.

Her flat is in a great location in the heart of Cihangir with lots of cool cafes and shops nearby. It is very clean and tidy and has beautiful views across Istanbul.

The guest flat is above Alev's and is reached via a ladder. Along with the bedroom, it has its own toilet and sink, sitting room and balcony. Downstairs you can use Alev's kitchen, sitting room and a second balcony with a little table and chairs.

The arrangement is a good one because it provides a (very spacious) private area whilst retaining the AirBnB experience of sharing with a local person.

The only downside was the low ceilings throughout the top level. My boyfriend, who is 5ft 10in, could only stand up in limited parts of the bedroom and sitting room, and had to stoop to use the bathroom sink. It wasn't a huge problem, but if he had been any taller it would have been difficult.

That was the only minus point to an otherwise great stay. Provided you are not a giant, I would wholly recommend Alev and her lovely flat.

Alev's attic is perfect for the flexible and open minded. It's a great location that combines hip neighborhood bars and restaurants, with a short 10 minute walk to the Galata Bridge that brings you to the old city. The place is very clean, private and the terrace has a nice view of the city. The noise is minimal, except for the inescapable calls for prayer. If you don't mind going up three flights of stairs and climbing a ships ladder to get to your room it's great exercise. Since the ceiling is angled, most of the time while you're up you'll have to stoop to walk from one part of the room to another, but my 6ft husband didn't mind. Alev is fluent in English and is very helpful and kind. The neighborhood provides a wide variety of place to eat and get your fill of tea and drinks. For breakfast we highly recommend Cihangir Patisserie Cafe at Defterdar Yokusu # 56, it's just up the hill and to the right from the apt. We ate there four times and Hasan, the owner is very friendly and generous. There is a trendier place down the street packed with tourist so skip the line and give Hasan's place a chance, you'll be charmed.

We stayed 5 nights at Alev's place and had a wonderful time. Her apartment is an easy downhill walk from Taksim Square, where all the Havataş shuttle buses from the airport and most public transportation end up, so it was very convenient getting there once we arrived in Istanbul, and Alev e-mailed us helpful directions beforehand. We had fun climbing up the ladder to get to our private space all to ourselves upstairs, and the whole apartment is airy and super super clean. We had our own private sink and toilet, and could take showers in the main spacious bathroom downstairs. The private terrace with its own couch swing was also a joy, and we loved the view. Alev is a gracious and accommodating host and we enjoyed chatting and watching Turkish tv with her! Overall, an excellent experience.

I spent a wonderful time in Istanbul in Alev's apartment with a friend.
We stayed 5 nights.
Alev was a perfect host, she was very helpful, she gave us a lot of informations, the last night she also helped us finding a place where to dance tango!

the location is central, the terraces are great, the apartment is clean and very nice. i loved to stay there. there was a quiet and relaxing atmosphere.

the only note is that there is a steep staircase to access the plan, it was not a problem for us but maybe it could be for someone and there was no door in the bathroom upstair, but this was not a problem for us.
alev also offered us to have a shower in her bathroom downstairs at any time.

i highly recommend a stay in her house!

reviews.text: Ev konum olarak beklentiyi karşıladı havalimanına çok yakındı, sakin bir bölgedeydi o sebeple evde dinlenmek için çok uygundu.genel anlamda düzenliydi, temizlik anlamında titiz boyutta değildi ama iyiydi, Dilek hanım adresi detaylı ifade etmiş fakat eve giriş için net talimatlar sunmadı, ufak bir iletişim sorunu hariç sorun çözmeye yönelik davrandı. Beklentimizi karşıladı.
Havalimanına çok yakın nezih bir muhit, temiz, tertipli bir ev, ilgili bir ev sahibi. Her şey için teşekkür ederim.

Rezervasyon yaparken ve girişte aşırı yavaştı ev sahibi. Mesajları sürekli geç yazdı fakat ilgiliydi. Fiyatta bir kişi için 250 lira düşerken 2 kişi için 100 lira düşmesi tuhaf geldi ama sistem isleyişi ile ilgili olabilir bilemiyorum. Ev tertemizdi. Girişte ulaşmamız gereken kişinin numarası yoktu. O beyefendi de yoktu fakat anahtar güvenlikteydi. Adres bilgisi yarım bir Türkçe ile yazılmıştı. Biraz zorlandık fakat bunlar önemsiz. Hanımefendi yurtdışında yaşıyormuş bazen aksaklık olabiliyormuş sırf bu yüzden Türkiye'ye geleceğini söyledi. Evi muazzamdı. Sessiz manzarası var denebilen bir balkon. oldukça keyif aldık. Çok mutlu olduk. Minimalist bir tarzda hoş bir evdi. Yine olsa KESİNLİKLE TERCİH EDERİM. SABİHA GÖKÇEN'E ÇOK YAKIN!

Dilek Hanım harika bir ev sahibi. Girişte ve çıkışta herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Temizlik ve hijyen konusunda herşey harikaydı. Mahremiyete ve güvenliğe önem verenler için tercih edilebilecek bir mekan.

Dilek hanım çok kibar. Anahtarı bize müsait olmamasına rağmen erken teslim etti. ev güzel bir sitede, gayet yeşil bir alana sahip. yağmurda kahvenizi alıp dışarıyı izlemek keyif verici.mahremiyetle ilgili problem yaşamazsınız. temizlik konusunda da bir problem yaşamadık. sadece yağ şeker gibi malzemeler hiç yoktu ama küçük bir ayrıntı. etrafta yemek sipariş edebileceğiniz bir sürü yer var. adres kolay bulunuyor. hemen bir sokak yukarı bir sürü otobüs park halinde olduğu bir durak var. her yere giden otobüsler bulabilirsiniz. konumunuza uygunsa tavsiye ederim.

description: Our rooftop house is spacious, artsy, musical and with a panoramic and airy terrace. You'll love the casual and friendly atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. It's the perfect spot to enjoy good vibes, good music, and good food and create unforgettable memories.

reviews.text:
Anna and her partner Shahab are truly amazing hosts! I stayed with them a little under a month and felt right at home. I was hesitant at booking for such a long time without checking out other places too, but I definitely made the right decision.
Not only is the place super clean, beautiful, sunny, has a great rooftop with an amazing view, but Anna and Shahab have become great friends. They helped me with my grad research, had Persian language exchange, helped me find a guitar instructor, have music jam sessions and we've had amazing conversations. They are also amazing cooks and it's been great staying there - really sad to leave!!
10/10 for a relaxing place with amazing people, with a metrobus and metro station a couple minutes' walk away. They also live right on top of Sok & Bim, two cheap grocery stores with different quick food options nearby.
Do not hesitate to book! :)

A safe haven 🌞
If you’re looking for a perfect hosting experience you shouldn’t hesitate and book one of Anna’s room ! 🔥
Hosting quality : Anna is living with her boyfriend Shahab, they are a lovely couple always warm and making sure everything is fine for you, plus Shahab is a real music enthusiast and musician.
You might have the chance to meet his friends (which are also having a band together) jamming on hot summer nights while sharing a tea !
Concerning Anna, she’s a real chief, I had the chance to taste her dishes for breakfast and for lunch and it was delicious everytime ! 😋
The place itself : it’s very well located I had no troubles visiting every touristic places with the public transportations, there is everything nearby (food/markets/shops/haircutter/etc) and the big plus : you have your own set of keys which means you can get in/out very easily and anytime.
The rooftop sight is perfect to appreciate the sunset and cooldown from a hot day of tour.
+ it’s very clean

Such a lovely place to stay with amazing hosts! Shahab and Anna are kind people who make you feel at home and answer any questions. The apartment is spotless clean and well taken care of. I felt right at home and very welcome. Internet worked great for working and video calls. Location is easy to use public transport. Would love to stay again if I am back in Istanbul.

Our time at Anna and Shahab’s was beyond great. They made our time in Turkey memorable. They are kind, warm and super conscious people. The apartment is spacious and clean, kitchen is fully equipped, and terrace has a beautiful view of the city. It’s very well located, walking distance from anything you’d need, and super close to public transportation. Def would recommend for a calm stay in Istanbul. Thank you Anna and Shahab!

We stayed 4 nights and felt right at home. Anna and Shahab were both very friendly, responsive and very proactive to help us. We reached at 12:30 am and Shahab even stayed up to greet us the first night.
Their place is a vibe. It is beautiful. The whole place was immaculate, especially the bathroom and kitchen. And the place is rich in character filled with many many quirky stuff that makes it special and unique. There are several good/local restaurants and bakeries nearby and lots of department stores as well. So eating was not a problem either.

description: A boutique apartment awaits you in the charming streets of Beyoglu, where history meets modern comfort! The serenity of Galataport and the energy of Taksim are just 5 minutes away. 19th century architecture comes to life with stylish details. Sip your coffee at Galataport in the morning, get lost in the colorful atmosphere of Taksim in the evening. With its historical texture, central location, and original design, this home is calling you! 🌟"

reviews.text:
The stay didn’t quite work out for me, mainly because of the location. The walk up to the apartment was brutal — an extremely steep hill, possibly the steepest I’ve ever climbed. I really wish there had been a clearer warning about the access, as it’s not ideal for everyone. The stairs inside the building were also quite unpleasant — narrow, dark, and difficult to manage with luggage. I felt exhausted just going in and out of the place.
Inside the apartment, there were a few issues as well: a wet towel was left behind in the kitchen, the bathroom had a strong, unpleasant smell (and was very small), and the lighting in the room was quite poor. The shower head was broken too. I did reach out to the host, and while she asked me to send a picture, I was too tired from traveling to follow up — though I believe she would’ve helped if I had.
On a positive note, the cleaning lady I met during checkout was kind and helpful

Excellent location on a narrow street right next to cocktail bars, shops & restaurants. Only a short 8 minute walk to Istaklal main strip up the road but away from the noise. Host is super friendly and responsive. Fast and stable WiFi speed for remote work and video meetings. The place is slightly dated in an older building but still worth the value. Appliances and washing machine could use updating. Bathroom and sleeping area are on the smaller side for 2 people but functional. Electrical sockets are coming out of the wall though still work and are safe to use. I would stay at this place again for slightly less price. Overall recommend for fantastic location and excellent WiFi.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is great, and everything I needed was close by. The host was very friendly and responsive, which made the experience even better. I would happily stay here again!”

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi!
Yunus Emre’nin evi gerçekten beklentimin üzerinde çıktı. Ev son derece temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda gördüğümden bile daha sıcak bir atmosfere sahipti. Salonun ferah yapısı, oturma grubunun rahatlığı ve dekorasyonun özenle seçilmiş olması konaklamayı çok keyifli hale getirdi.
Konum olarak da oldukça avantajlı; market, ulaşım ve ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her şeye yakın. Evdeki çift katmanlı stor perdeler hem gündüz ışığını güzel alıyor hem de gece tam karartma sağlıyor. Klima, TV, mutfak ekipmanları… ihtiyaç duyduğum her şey eksiksizdi.
Yunus Emre iletişim konusunda da çok ilgiliydi. Hızlı, çözüm odaklı ve misafirperver. Kendimi evimde gibi hissettirdi.
Kesinlikle tekrar tercih ederim. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ediyorum!

Daire resimlerde görüldüğüyle birebir aynıydı. Temiz ve düzenli kendimi evimde gibi rahat hissettiğim bir evdi. Konum olarak merkezi ve hem tramvay hem de metro ile ulaşıma müsait yürüme mesafesindeydi. Ev sahibi her konuda yardımcı oldu ve anında dönüt sağladı
