reviews.text:
Our stay at Elit Palace was fantastic. The place was beautiful and fully equipped with everything we needed and more. Mr. Sedat, was very responsive and ensured a smooth stay! A special shoutout to Bashir, the Guest Relations Manager, who took such great care of us and truly went above and beyond to ensure we had a seamless and comfortable stay.
The location is perfect, with Marmarapark Alışveriş and Akbatı AVM just a 6-minute drive away. Akbatı even has an indoor tennis court. Many Baklava stores are within walking distance, and Migros and Happy Center are open until 10 PM for groceries. There are also three ATM machines by the parking entrance for easy withdrawals in USD or TL.
For food, "EMİR BURGER" is a 10-minute walk away, and "Hafize Topal Güzellik Salonu" is nearby for hair and nail care. Alcohol stores, "Tekel Shop," are just 2 minutes' walk and stay open late, even on weekends.
We felt at home and would definitely return if Sedat would have us :) Highly recommend it!

It was a beautiful apartment in a great location. We had everything we needed. The beds were comfortable. The shower was good. The kitchen was well-equipped. It was great to be so close to the centre of town. Mr Sedat, was very friendly and helpful. I hope to see you again!

Close to shops and restaurants easy to walk around, the check in was easy my advice is to have more plates in the kitchen the bathroom we noticed the water was leaking from the bottom of the shower screen everything else was fine easy to communicate with the host

Hızlı ve pratik çözümleri hızlı geri dönüşleriyle kafanızda soru işareti bırakmayacak bir ev sahibi sedat bey. Ev fotoğraflardaki kadar temiz ve düzenliydi :) kendisini ve evini güvenerek tercih edebilirsiniz

Sedat is a great host! he is very responsive and provided me with clear instructions to check in. The apartment is great, it is luxurious, it has everything you need! great view from the 10th floor, walking distance to restaurants, banks, ATM, shops, easy access to transportation and taxis, very safe and secure with 24/7 security! I strongly recommend Sedat and his place! Thank you, Sedat, for the world-class service and quality!

description: This suite has a private kitchenette and a private bathroom with jacuzzi. There is 24 hours door man and once every 2 days cleaning service. The complex has private Turkish bath, sauna and fitness room. The turkish bath and sauna is private and need to be booked upon arrival for free entrance. There is a shared sea view roof terrace.

reviews.text:
Yusuf, as described by others, is a great host. He welcomed us with Chai and Coffee and carried our luggage to the room even if I didn't expect him to :)

The room was comfortable, VERY clean and had everything as listed. We did feel it got a little cold at night but the blankets were warm, clean and soft and provided for a perfect setting to get cozy. Not a big deal.

The housekeeping was excellent and I found all my scattered clothes carefully and neatly folded when I returned back to my room in the evening. Thanks to the housekeepers!

Yusuf and his team also helped Me and my friend to book transportation to the airport for departure which was great. They gave great suggestions for having lunch and dinner and provided answers to any and every question that we had.

We had an issue with the warm water in the room we were first offered, it looked muddy, which was disappointing as we only noticed it on the 3rd day while filling the bath tub. However, Yusuf quickly provided us a brand new room which was exactly like the one we had before, but of course, without the plumbing problem. Exactly what a good host would do!

The location is great if you want to stay in the heart of the city without spending a fortune. And if the weather is sunny, make sure to check out the terrace. The evening sun and the sight of the distant sea, rejuvenates your senses! And ask Yusuf about the places to dine and drink :)

Overall, a pleasant stay.

Thank you Yusuf!

Spatious studio in superb location, 5min to supermarkets, 10min to main imperial sightseeing attractions and to the tram station. It was clean, and was cleaned every 2-3 days during our 8-night stay. Despite being on a busy one-way street, there is good noise insulation and so we had no problem to sleep. The kitchen has the basic utilities (couple of pans, kettle, pot, fridge), as well as complimentary coffee and tea. Additionally, in the building there's a reception area where there's someone 24h a day and you can also rest and have some complimentary coffee/tea and biscuits. The staff are very helpful; in fact, Erol kindly offered to receive a packet for us when, due to an unexpected event, we had to have it sent to us. And last, but not least, there's a lovely sauna-hamman, completely private, which was a fantastic experience for us- though I was skeptical at first, it turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip! I also recommend that you book an airport transfer with them since it ends up being cheaper than taxi drivers and noone tries to cheat you into paying more (unlike taxi drivers).

Felt very welcome on arrival with friendly staff, welcome drink, cookies and tourist map. Room clean and good size with a kitchenette. If your looking for friendly and helpful staff, clean room and sheets at a good price this is your place. They have a lift too! Not everything is perfect compared to a **** hotel but most of us can overlook curtain rings missing and cords not hidden. I would definitely love to stay there again and will when we return.

Highly recommended! Yusuf place is beautiful and is perfectly located! The unit is exactly like the pictures. The room was beautifully decorated with a full kitchen and two individual couches that can be converted to beds. The room was super clean and with AC. The best thing about this place is theirs hosts. They were so welcoming and provided all the information needed for tours and places to visit. They arranged us a beautiful full day tour which we recommend also. Yusuf was always very attentive to our needs and provided us with cookies, coffee and tea everyday at every hour. The cookies were the best! The location was also ideal since its 10 min walk to all center attractions, bazaars and mosques. You can find many restaurants and shops walking distance as well. Overall we had a great time! Thank you so much for everything! We will definitely come back!

Yusuf was an amazing host and was such a pleasure to talk to. The hotel is beautiful. the room is exactly as it appears in the pictures - clean, spacious, and very comfortable. The jacuzzi was amazing after a long day of walking around the city!! The neighbourhood was quiet with loads of little restaurants around. Easily walkable to the major sites, or to the tram to head up to the river or across the water to the funky neighbourhoods on the other side. I would most certainly stay here again.

description: Have fun with the whole family at this stylish place.

reviews.text: The apartment is spacious and very comfortable. It is beautifully furnished, equipped with everything you need to feel at home, including a microwave (a big plus). We enjoyed the quiet, the view and the secure interior of the residential complex. The only small inconvenience was related to the fact that having a car with foreign number plates, we could not access the underground parking, but the outdoor parking was not a problem: there were plenty of places available around the residential complex. The host, Mr. Anas, a very friendly person and attentive to the complaints of his customers. We thank him for his kindness! In conclusion, the perfect place for a family. But not only.

Enes was an amazing host! He was very personable and felt comfortable asking him for anything we needed. We were far away from home but his place felt just like home. It was clean and tidy and very spacious. Although it was far from touristy places, we knew that ahead of time and had no problem catching a cab right outside our place. Highly recommend!
Home away from home , beautiful location and amazing host , cleanliness is top notch 🙏👌thank you

Anas is an excellent host. He is very helpful and responsive and was of great hospitality the entire stay. The flat is classy, elegant, and well-equipped, and Anas provided everything we needed from Tupperware to hangers. He is also an excellent communicator and provided us with recommendations and help throughout. I overall recommend this flat for a long stay because of the facilities that exist inside the Batisehir complex: shuttle to metro, pools, supermarket, gym, and recreational activities.
Thank you Anas for making our stay enjoyable and lovely.

The apartment was amazing,clean, and fully loaded with everything needed. The host went above and beyond what was expected! Very helpful at anytime and very friendly! I have been to Istanbul 5 times this was the best stay! I will definitely be coming back to stay here!

description: Enjoy modern amenities in a newly built, secure, and clean environment. We're in the heart of vibrant Sakızağacı Mahallesi, well-connected for exploring Istanbul's attractions therefore you can immerse yourself in local culture with nearby shops, cafes, and restaurants.

reviews.text: Great place in a great neighborhood. Good hospitality I would’ve suggested little cleaning detergent for the kitchen and at least couple of kitchen wear, the bed was not comfortable
Thank you for everything

Really recommend this place for solo travellers. Thank you!
